focusFeat.name: Start of Turn
focusFeat.description: Gain 1 Focus at the start of your turn

reactions.name: Opportunity Attack
reactions.trigger: A hostile creature leaves your melee range while you have a non-Implement melee weapon equipped
reactions.description: Deal fixed physical damage to the target equal to your melee weapon damage

nomadic.name: Nomadic
nomadic.description: You traveled from place to place, never staying too long in one location.

rural.name: Rural
rural.description: You grew up in the countryside where most people cultivated the land. The population was small.

secluded.name: Secluded
secluded.description: You grew up in a sheltered environment, far away from most people. You did not interact with other cultures often.

urban.name: Urban
urban.description: You grew up in a large populated area with many types of people

wilderness.name: Wilderness
wilderness.description: You grew up in the wilderness probably following a hunter/gatherer lifestyle

bureaucratic.name: Bureaucratic
bureaucratic.description: You have spent a significant portion of your life dealing with paperwork and red tape

communal.name: Communal
communal.description: You have spent a significant portion of your life in a tight-knit community

academic.name: Academic
academic.description: You were raised by people who valued education and knowledge

creative.name: Creative
creative.description: You were raised by those who created art or otherwise whose work strongly involved the arts

labor.name: Labor
labor.description: You were surrounded by those who performed physical labor

lawless.name: Lawless
lawless.description: You were grew up amongst those who line of business would be considered less than legal

noble.name: Noble
noble.description: You grew up with those who were leaders and frequently played political games to maintain power

artisan.name: Artisan
artisan.description: A master of a specific craft or trade

beggar.name: Beggar
beggar.description: One who survived the streets through wit and plea

explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.description: You spent a lot of time in the wilderness either as a travel guide, cartographer, or treasure hunter

farmer.name: Farmer
farmer.description: You worked the land either with crops or animals

mercenary.name: Mercenary
mercenary.description: You were a sell-sword or a gladiator

performer.name: Performer
performer.description: You provided entertainment for a living

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.description: You immersed yourself in studying the world itself

sailor.name: Sailor
sailor.description: You traveled the high seas either as a pirate, treasure hunter, or to help ship goods

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.description: You either worked as a guard or fought in wars

warden.name: Warden
warden.description: You protected a nature in a specific region similar to a forest ranger

student.name: Student
student.description: You are a student in a reputable institute of education

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.description: Creating and identifying potions and poisons

cooking.name: Cooking
cooking.description: Once per day you can cook food during a short rest to restore additional HP. Make a Willpower roll.

forgery.name: Forgery
forgery.description: Preparing fake documents or ids; identifying legitimate documentation

mechanic.name: Mechanic
mechanic.description: Working with or creating magitech machines

smithing.name: Smithing
smithing.description: Ability to work metal and upgrade gear

tailoring.name: Tailoring
tailoring.description: Ability to work cloth or leather, prepare clothing, and create disguises

acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
acrobatics.description: Doing gymnastics or walking a tight rope

athletics.name: Athletics
athletics.description: Traversing walls and cliffs; swimming in strong currents

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.description: Giving first aid and identifying illnesses

scouting.name: Scouting
scouting.description: Navigating the wilderness; fishing and hunting

insight.name: Insight
insight.description: Understanding behavior/intentions, detecting lies, and deception

persuasion.name: Persuasion
persuasion.description: Trying to convince someone to agree with you

search.name: Search
search.description: Searching environments for clues, details, or traps

arcana.name: Arcana
arcana.description: General magical knowledge, history, and the nature of magic

criminal expertise.name: Criminal Expertise
criminal expertise.description: Understanding criminal organizations, relationships, and leaders

creature knowledge.name: Creature Knowledge
creature knowledge.description: Knowing weaknesses and behavior of less common creatures

history.name: History
history.description: Knowing major events in the past

nature.name: Nature
nature.description: Knowing weaknesses and behavior of common creatures

religion.name: Religion
religion.description: Knowing religious mythologies, practices, and rituals

dualWielding.name: Dual Wielding
dualWielding.description: If you have already attacked with a one-handed weapon this turn with an action then your next weapon attack this turn using a different one-handed weapon with an action has its AP cost reduced by 1. If both weapon are Light then its AP cost is reduced by 2 instead. Both attacks must have an original AP cost of no more than 2. This can only be used once per round and neither of these actions can be a spell.

manaStrike.name: Mana Strike
manaStrike.description: Once per round you can spend 5 Mana to add half your Rea, WiP, or Pre modifier (round up) to your weapon attack's damage.

coupDeGrace.name: Coup de Grace
coupDeGrace.description: Your melee attacks on a prone target gain double Boon instead of Boon.

improvedThrowing.name: Improved Throwing
improvedThrowing.description: Increase Throwing range by 3 tiles and damage by 1

dedicatedStrike.name: Dedicated Strike
dedicatedStrike.description: When you attack with a 2H non-Firearm weapon with an action that costs 2 AP or more you may reduce your Defense by 2 (min 0) and give up your step to deal +2 damage on this attack. These penalties last until the start of your next turn.

patientShooter.name: Patient Shooter
patientShooter.description: Starting from the second round if you have not changed positions the entire previous round and you know Steady Aim then your first ranged attack this round automatically gains the benefit of Steady Aim.

naturalist.name: Naturalist
naturalist.description: Whenever you use a healing consumable like a herb to heal, an additional 2 HP is restored.

spearCharge.name: Spear Charge
spearCharge.description: If you use Charge while wielding a polearm you deal +1 damage.

mobileCover.name: Mobile Cover
mobileCover.description: While you have a shield equipped you act as cover to adjacent allies whose size is no bigger than yours

touchRam.name: Touchram
touchRam.description: You may use Implement weapons for Opportunity attacks, using half the weapon's damage (round up) as the damage

featherFall.name: Featherfall
featherFall.description: When you or an ally is about to suffer fall damage you may spend 10 Mana to reduce that fall damage by half for up to 3 targets

concentration.name: Concentration
concentration.description: When you use an action that has a Maintain tag you gain 3 Barrier

duelingStance.name: Dueling Stance
duelingStance.description: If you only have a 1H weapon equipped in one hand and nothing in the other then that weapon's damage increases by 1

fineMotorUpgrade.name: Fine motor upgrade
fineMotorUpgrade.description: The mechanical arm from the Artificer's Tinker's Armor can now hold and fire 1H ranged weapons for you.

pistolMaster.name: Pistol Master
pistolMaster.description: You may treat Pistols as Light weapons. Your Max MP is increased by 6.

destructiveKi.name: Destructive Ki
destructiveKi.description: You no longer gain the Opportunity attack from Chain Strike. Your attacks with Brawling weapons automatically gain Penetration (3).

flowingKi.name: Flowing Ki
flowingKi.description: Your Force Palm attacks have their ranged increased to 5 and deal magical damage. Whenever you are allowed to make an Opportunity Attack you may instead replace it with a Force Palm with no AP cost.

spellblade.name: Spellblade
spellblade.description: If you cast a spell this turn then your next weapon attack this turn can be used with -1 AP cost as long as the weapon is not 2H, Heavy, or Firearm and neither the spell nor weapon attack has an original AP cost of more than 2. If you attack with a weapon this turn then your next spell this turn can be cast with -1 AP cost, but the original AP cost of both the weapon attack and spell must be at most 2. This can only be used once per round.

trustyCompanion.name: Trusty Companion
trustyCompanion.description: You gain one small Beast or Plant companion as an Assistant. Their attacks have a range centered on you, but are usually treated as Melee. Choose two companion abilities from Bite, Scratch, Tackle, and Protect.

seismicToss.name: Seismic Toss
seismicToss.description: You ignore 2 Stability when throwing a creature.

metalHarmony.name: Metal Harmony
metalHarmony.description: You can cast spells while wearing martial armor

aerialMenace.name: Aerial Menace
aerialMenace.description: Your ranged attacks deal +3 damage against flying targets

crossbowMaster.name: Crossbow Master
crossbowMaster.description: Your attacks with crossbows gain Penetrate (2)

runAndGun.name: Run and Gun
runAndGun.description: After making a ranged weapon attack whose AP cost is no more than 2 you may shift 1.

selflessness.name: Selflessness
selflessness.description: Whenever you are healed in combat by an ally that is not yourself you may spend a Reaction and 2 Mana to restore 3 HP to all allies within 2 tiles.

warden.name: Warden
warden.description: Once per round if a creature enters your melee range and you have a polearm equipped you may make an Opportunity Attack on them with the polearm as a free Reaction.

waveSwing.name: Wave Swing
waveSwing.description: You can use Wave Swing action

wellTimedBlock.name: Well-timed Block
wellTimedBlock.description: After the first time you raise your shield per round, the damage of the next Opportunity Attack you suffer is reduced by your shield's defense

crossBlock.name: Cross Block
crossBlock.description: While dual wielding you gain +1 Stability

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: If you kill a non-minion class enemy with a melee attack whose AP cost is at least 2 AP using a 2H weapon you may immediately make an Opportunity Attack on another creature in range using half your weapon's damage (round up)

refinedControl.name: Refined Control
refinedControl.description: By giving up one of your AP on your turn you may grant an additional AP to one of your Summons on their turn this round

featureCreep.name: Feature Creep
featureCreep.description: If you chose Compound Weapon or Tinker's Armor you can make one more choice from your options.

tenacity.name: Tenacity
tenacity.description: You increase your Max HP by 8

greaterAnimalCompanion.name: Greater Animal Companion
greaterAnimalCompanion.description: Choose 2 effects. For each effect either one of your animal companion's actions gains that effect or you gain a new Action.

subtleCast.name: Subtle Cast
subtleCast.description: If you double the mana cost of a spell you may cast the spell quietly and without the usual magical light effects.

violentcast.name: Violentcast
violentcast.description: When you kill an enemy with magic damage you deal 3 damage of the same type to all hostile creatures within 1 tile.

tightGrip.name: Tight Grip
tightGrip.description: You may treat non-Heavy two-handed melee weapons as 1H and Heavy weapons no longer increase AP costs. These 2H weapons can be used for either 1H or 2H abilities interchangeably.

rampart.name: Rampart
rampart.description: For the first round of combat until you start your turn you gain Resistance to all damage types

magicPenetration.name: Magic Penetration
magicPenetration.description: You may double the mana cost of a spell to ignore resistance.

extremeEvasion.name: Extreme Evasion
extremeEvasion.description: When using Evasion you warp instead of shift after the triggering attack

criticalEdge.name: Critical Edge
criticalEdge.description: When attacking a creature that has a status effect or you are flanking you can also roll a critical success on an 18

parryMaster.name: Parry Master
parryMaster.description: You may use Parry on non-melee attacks as well. Parry becomes a free Reaction.

solidStance.name: Solid Stance
solidStance.description: Brawler Stances last 1 minute instead of 18 seconds now

improvedScratchDmg.name: Improved Scratch Damage
improvedScratchDmg.description: Minimum physical damage after defense is increased from 1 to 2

artificer.name: Artificer
artificer.description:
Artificers use the power of Magitech to create inventions and items for either support or damage.
Artificer - You can use firearms and your Artificer spells can be cast even while wearing martial armor.

focusFeat.name: Item Obsessed
focusFeat.description: The first time per round you or your allies use an item, spend IP, or utilize an Implement weapon for any action or reaction you gain 1 Focus

sharingIsCaring.name: Sharing is Caring
sharingIsCaring.description: You can give your IP to other party members during a short rest if you have a Bond with them.

implementConsolidation.name: Implement Consolidation
implementConsolidation.description: You can attach your Implement to one of your weapons, freeing up one of your hands.

specialInvention.name: Special Invention
specialInvention.description: At level 3, choose one invention: Potion Launcher (launcher + extra-large alchemy satchel), Trap Dispenser Belt, Modular Armor (pick two modules), or Support Backpack (pick two modules; Weapon Infusion requires a damage type).

potionLauncher.name: Potion Launcher
potionLauncher.description: Grants a potion launcher and an extra-large alchemy satchel.

trapBelt.name: Trap Dispenser Belt
trapBelt.description: Deployable actions can be performed twice as fast at double IP cost.

modularArmor.name: Modular Armor
modularArmor.description: Artificer's armor (Defense 4, martial). Pick two invention modules.

supportBackpack.name: Support Backpack
supportBackpack.description: Unlimited-capacity back container. Pick two invention modules.

actionCard.name: Minor Synthesize
actionCard.description:
Create one of the following alchemical creations. You may reduce the IP cost by 1 if you spend the corresponding ingredient instead:
		- Vial of Glue - Slime Nuclei
		- Minor Healing Potion - Traveler's Grass
		- Vial of Oil - Amber
		- Vial of Poison - Alexander Root

actionCard.name: Healing Bullet
actionCard.description: Fire a bullet that heals on impact.

actionCard.name: Bear Trap
actionCard.description: Create and deploy a metal bear trap on an unoccupied tile. When someone steps on it they must make a Might Power Roll and take the corresponding piercing damage.

actionCard.name: Elemental Coating
actionCard.description:
Create a coating that can only applies to projectiles used by ranged weapon attacks. You may immediately use this coating on a weapon you're holding. Using this coating on a weapon give it an Infusion of the chosen damage type for the next ranged weapon attack using the weapon only. You may only have one of these at a time. Choose from the following:
- Air
- Volt
- Earth
- Nature

actionCard.name: Pressurized Balloon
actionCard.description: Create and deploy a pressurized balloon. When it takes damage it pops, pushing back all creatures within 1 tile of it, forcing them to make a Might power roll.

actionCard.name: Deployable Shield
actionCard.description: Create and deploy a semi-transparent shield that acts as cover. You may only have up to 2 of these deployed at a time.

actionCard.name: Flamethrower
actionCard.description: Release flames into a 3x3 area whose edge is adjacent to you, dealing fire damage to all creatures in the area. Flames remain in the area for 1 minute.

actionCard.name: Synthesize
actionCard.description:
Create one of the following alchemical creations. You may reduce the IP cost by 1 if you spend the corresponding ingredient instead:
		- Vial of Acid - Blister Leaf
		- Healing Potion - Heal Root
		- Smokepowder Vial - Puffball Spores
		- Anti-coagulant - Minor Snake Venom

actionCard.name: Shotgun Blast
actionCard.description: Create and fire a bullet that spreads into a 3x3 area whose edge is adjacent to you, dealing magical piercing damage to all creatures in the area. If there is only one creature in the area it deals +3 damage. Afterwards you shift 2 backwards. This action does not gain a Bane from being within 1 tile of a hostile creature.

actionCard.name: Electro Bomb
actionCard.description: Creates a bomb that explodes in a 3x3 area centered on the bomb dealing volt damage.

actionCard.name: Personal Barrier
actionCard.description: Grant yourself some Barrier

actionCard.name: Repeating Shot
actionCard.description: Fire a burst of bullets from your firearm.

actionCard.name: Turret
actionCard.description: Create and deploy a stone turret on an adjacent unoccupied tile. This turret is treated as an object, but has 1 HP and 5 Def. The turret has charges equal to your Reason modifier. Whenever a hostile creatures within 12 tiles Strides or attacks an ally it shoots magical rocks at them, dealing earth damage. Afterwards 1 charge is lost. When no charges remain the turret crumbles to dust. You may only have up to 2 turrets at a time.

actionCard.name: Holographic Projector
actionCard.description: Display 2 holograms of yourself that shimmer and move around you, making it hard to determine your true location. While the holograms persist attacks against you gain a Bane and you gain 3 Defense. Lose 1 hologram after taking damage from any source.

reactions.name: Mini Radar
reactions.trigger: A Concealed creature attacks an ally within 3 tiles of you
reactions.description: Use your radar to detect the attack beforehand, allowing you to warn them and remove the Boon granted by Concealment to the attacker.

reactions.name: Scavenge
reactions.trigger: A hostile creature dies within 2 tiles of you
reactions.description: Shift to their location and quickly scavenge the body for resources, restoring 1 IP.

bard.name: Bard
bard.description: The Bard uses the power of music to control the tempo of battle.

focusFeat.name: Lyrical Pride
focusFeat.description: At the start of your turn, if there are at least 3 creatures within 8 tiles that can be affected by your Songs, you gain 1 Focus.

tapDancing.name: Tap Dancing
tapDancing.description: Once you start a Song this round you may immediately shift 1.

segue.name: Segue
segue.description: You may make Opportunity Attacks with your instrument, dealing damage equal to half your Presence modifier, rounding up

backupSinger.name: Backup Singer
backupSinger.description: You gain a tiny pet animal like a small frog or parrot as an Assistant that can repeat your song at the start of your next turn.

targetAudience.name: Target Audience
targetAudience.description: When you play a Song with the Emanation tag you may choose who is affected by it.

actionCard.name: Melody of Tranquility
actionCard.description: Play a song of gentle peace, causing all affected targets to be afflicted with weakened.

actionCard.name: Riff of Rage
actionCard.description:
Play a song of fiery vengeance. All affected creatures are Sundered during this song. 

Focus 3: Any creature afflicted with Bleeding is immediately affected by Hemorrhage.

actionCard.name: Ode of Healing
actionCard.description: Heal affected creatures with the power of your music.

actionCard.name: Chant of the Dying
actionCard.description: Choose 2 targets. Play a song of death, causing the target to see illusions of specters and undead. Deals physical dark damage.

actionCard.name: Note Blast
actionCard.description: Unleash a blast of air, either with your voice or instrument, dealing physical air damage

actionCard.name: Echolocation
actionCard.description: Release an upbeat song that helps triangulate enemy locations, revealing the location of and negating the benefits of Concealed for all hostile creatures in the area for the duration

actionCard.name: Symphony of Dance
actionCard.description: Play an upbeat song of dance. All affected creatures have their Speed increased by 2. Remove Slowed or Restrained effects. They do not trigger Opportunity Attacks.

actionCard.name: Unnecessary Squeaking
actionCard.description: Does not affect allies. Play a song so badly that it makes everyone want to stop you.

actionCard.name: Dance Sequence
actionCard.description: Force your targets to move according to your dance routine

actionCard.name: Pitch Trauma
actionCard.description: Inflict bleeding onto all affected creatures.

actionCard.name: Hymn of Flowing Water
actionCard.description: End up to 2 status effects on each affected target. Grant Barrier.

actionCard.name: Rhapsody of War
actionCard.description: All targets gain Penetrate (3), mana costs reduced by 3, and can shift up to Speed as a free Reaction.

reactions.name: Spellsinger
reactions.trigger: An ally that can hear you while you are playing a Song spends mana during combat
reactions.description: They regain 3 Mana

reactions.name: Can't stop the music
reactions.trigger: You are about to take physical damage while you or your pet is playing a Song
reactions.description: You gain resistance to physical damage for the rest of the round

brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.description: The Brawler is proficient with unarmed combat and fighting with low armor. They excel in close range and are focused on improving their bodies.

focusFeat.name: CQC
focusFeat.description: If you start your turn within 1 tile of a hostile creature you gain 1 Focus.

chainStrike.name: Chain Strike
chainStrike.description: After you attack with a Brawling weapon as part of an action you may make an Opportunity Attack with a Brawling weapon. If you spend 1 Focus you can add Repeat(2) to this Opportunity Attack. Your target does not have to be the same as the first. You can also treat your fists as a weapon for the sake of changing damage types.

onTheMove.name: On the Move
onTheMove.description: After you inflict forced movement on a hostile creature with a melee action you may shift 1 if you do not have martial armor equipped.

unarmoredDefense.name: Unarmored Defense
unarmoredDefense.description: If you are not wearing martial armor or any shields you gain a bonus to defense equal to your Dexterity modifier (max 3).

gentleSteps.name: Gentle Steps
gentleSteps.description: You can shift through difficult terrain.

brawler.freeFeaturesNote: You gain proficiency with brawling weapons. Your fists have their damage increased to 1 instead of 0. You can flex your muscles hard enough to rip cloth clothes to shreds (leaving you shirtless) if you are not wearing armor.

actionCard.name: Swift Kick
actionCard.description: Kick them, dealing crushing damage. If the target is prone then it becomes a stomp, dealing +2 damage.

actionCard.name: Eagle Strike
actionCard.description: Flip over your target as you strike them. If there is an unoccupied tile on the exact opposite side of them you may warp 3 to the opposite side if in range.

actionCard.name: Force Palm
actionCard.description: Emit a short blast of energy from your open palm, dealing crushing damage

actionCard.name: Sweeping Kick
actionCard.description: Knock your target's feet out from under them

actionCard.name: Ox Stance
actionCard.description: Enter an enhanced state for the duration. In this stance your Speed is set to 1, but you gain 8 Barrier on use and during the Start Phase. You also gain 1 Stability. Your Might modifier is treated as 1 higher than it normally is for the sake of resisting Potencies.

actionCard.name: Rabbit Stance
actionCard.description: Enter an enhanced state for the duration. In this stance your Speed is increased by 3, your step is increased to 2 tiles and is treated as shift instead of stride. Your Dexterity modifier is treated as 1 higher than it normally is for the sake of resisting Potencies.

actionCard.name: Spiral Fist
actionCard.description: Unleash a single focused strike to punch through your target's armor

actionCard.name: Swallow Kick
actionCard.description: You unleash a powerful kick, dealing physical air damage

actionCard.name: Tiger Stance
actionCard.description: Enter an enhanced state for the duration. In this stance all your melee attacks gain a Boon and deal +2 damage.

actionCard.name: Ki Bomb
actionCard.description: Force your ki into your target dealing magical crushing damage. The next time they take damage increase the forced movement by 2 or add push 2 if none exists.

actionCard.name: Stunning Strike
actionCard.description: Aim for the target's meridians to inhibit their mobility

actionCard.name: Gentle Fist
actionCard.description: Force your energy into their body with this strike, causing their blood vessels to rupture

actionCard.name: Snake Stance
actionCard.description: Enter an enhanced state for the duration. You cannot have multiple Stances active at once. In this stance your first melee attack per round gains Penetrate (5). Additionally your attacks on poisoned targets gain a Boon.

reactions.name: Move like a Butterfly
reactions.trigger: A hostile creature casts a spell within 3 tiles of you
reactions.description: You may shift 1. If this would put you into melee range of the caster and they're using a ranged attack they do not get the bane for having an enemy in melee range for this attack.

reactions.name: Redirection
reactions.trigger: You are subjected to forced movement
reactions.description: Reduce the distance by 2 after factoring in Stability. If the remaining distance is 0 then you may instead inflict slide 2 on the attacker after the attack. This slide ignores stability

conjurer.name: Conjurer
conjurer.description: Mages that can summon and buff allies.

focusFeat.name: Shared Connection
focusFeat.description: If you start your turn within 5 tiles of a friendly creature you gain 1 Focus.

arcaneAegis.name: Arcane Aegis
arcaneAegis.description: If you have cast a spell on an ally this turn you take 5 reduced magic damage lasting until the start of the End Phase.

tacticalReallocation.name: Tactical Reallocation
tacticalReallocation.description: Whenever you dismiss an Assistant, Summon, or group of minions you regain the lesser of either 15 mana or half the mana cost to summon the dismissed creature (round down).

summoner.name: Summoner
summoner.description:
You can use Golemancy or Necromancy to create a summon or minions to fight for you. You can spend 1 AP on your turn to give it a command for this turn or it won't be able to act. You may only have one summon or group of minions active at a time. Refer to Summon Guidelines.

Rules:
- When you select this passive you must choose Golemancy or Necromancy. You cannot have both.
- You may obtain one available Summoning spell for free when you first take this passive. You gain one additional Summon each time you gain another level of Conjurer.
- Summons can last until the beginning of your next Long Rest.
- The strength of your Summon and amount of minions you can have at one time is determined by your Summon Mastery which starts at rank 1. This also determines what Summoning spell you can learn.
- Rank 1: Rank 1 Summon or 2 minions at once.
- Rank 2: Rank 2 Summon or 3 minions at once.

greatSummoner.name: Great Summoner
greatSummoner.description: Your Summon Mastery increases to rank 2. Whenever you dismiss an Assistant, Summon, or group of minions you regain the lesser of either 15 mana or half the mana cost to summon the dismissed creature (round down).

conjurer.freeFeaturesNote: You cannot cast Conjurer spells while wearing martial armor. Elemental aspects for your spells: Earth, Dark.

actionCard.name: Sharpness
actionCard.description:
Choose a target. Until the end of the round that creature's weapon attacks have Extend and Penetrate (3).

Maintain: During the start phase you may spend 1 Focus and 5 Mana to maintain this ability. If you do so then the effect is active for this round as well.

actionCard.name: Rock Armor
actionCard.description:
Choose a target. Nearby rocks form around them, increasing their defense by 3 and making them Slowed.

Maintain: During the start phase you may spend 1 Focus and 5 Mana to maintain this ability. If you do so then the effect is active for this round as well.

actionCard.name: Pebble Blast
actionCard.description: Fire magically infused pebbles at the target, dealing earth damage.

actionCard.name: Summoner's Infusion
actionCard.description: Give Infusion (Earth) or Infusion (Dark) depending on whether you chose Geomancy or Necromancy to your weapon or an ally's weapon. That weapon's damage type changes to earth. You may only have one of these active at a time. You cannot use this if you don't have the Summoner passive.

actionCard.name: Totem of Anger
actionCard.description: Summon a wooden totem in an unoccupied tile. All allies within 1 tile of it have their weapon attack damage increased by 2.

actionCard.name: Reinforce
actionCard.description: Remove Sundered from an ally and make them immune to the effects of Sundered for the rest of the round

actionCard.name: Reconstruction
actionCard.description: Restore HP to a friendly Construct or Undead.

actionCard.name: Summon Minion
actionCard.description: Summon a minion group of your choice

actionCard.name: Action Advance
actionCard.description: Must be used during the Fast Phase. Select a willing creature acting during the Slow Phase. They may now act during the Fast Phase for this round only.

actionCard.name: Keen Call
actionCard.description: Choose an ally. Their next Power Roll gains double boon.

actionCard.name: Final Order
actionCard.description: On use the target immediately gains 2 AP. This does not grant them another turn. When the Delay effect triggers they lose HP equal to half of their max HP (round up). If used on your Summon this spell has a different effect. The AP bonus lasts until the Summon dies. You must provide it with one last order. It will perform that order until it dies. The Delay effect does not happen for the Summon.

actionCard.name: Exceed
actionCard.description: For the duration the target does not trigger Opportunity Attacks and has their Speed doubled. They do not suffer the AP cost penalty of Heavy weapons. They also gain a Boon on attacks against targets who haven't acted yet this round.

actionCard.name: Echo Strike
actionCard.description: Choose an ally. Once per round whenever the target makes a melee attack that is not an Opportunity attack they may add Repeat(2) to that attack.

reactions.name: Concentration
reactions.trigger: You take excessive damage that would disrupt your Maintain spell
reactions.description: Your Maintain spell does not end

reactions.name: Mirage Swap
reactions.trigger: An ally within 3 tiles of you is targeted by an attack while your Summon is within 5 tiles of you
reactions.description: Swap the locations of the target and your Summon. Your Summon takes the attack instead.

fairytamer.name: Fairy Tamer
fairytamer.description: Fairy Tamers form contracts with Fairies who travel with them and aid them. Although they don't innately possess many spells compared to other casters their fairies can instead cast for them. They also have wide elemental coverage.

focusFeat.name: Safe Positioning
focusFeat.description: If you start your turn with no more than 2 enemies within 1 tile of you you gain 1 Focus.

fairyContract.name: Fairy Contract
fairyContract.description:
You can form contracts with Fairies and they are treated as Assistants. Fairies go to sleep when you do so you need to re-summon them after a Long Rest. You can select fairies to form a contract with at the following Fairy Tamer levels by spending Class XP. If you didn't form a contract with them when you reach that Fairy Tamer level due to not having this passive you may retroactively do so later.
- Level 1: 1 Lesser Fairy
- Level 2: 1 Lesser Fairy
- Level 3: 1 Lesser Fairy
- Level 5: 1 Lesser Fairy or upgrade 1 Lesser Fairy to a Greater Fairy

fairysSacrifice.name: Fairy's Sacrifice
fairysSacrifice.description: On your turn you may dismiss one of your summoned fairies as a free Reaction to remove one status effect on yourself or an ally within 2 tiles.

protectiveManifestation.name: Protective Manifestation
protectiveManifestation.description: While one of your Manifest spells is active you gain resistance to the corresponding damage type.

energyTransfer.name: Energy Transfer
energyTransfer.description: When a hostile creature is killed within 3 tiles of you you gain 3 mana.

fairytamer.freeFeaturesNote: You can perceive Metaphysical beings. Fairy Tamer: You can communicate with and sometimes even request help from other fairies even if you're not bound to them (see the Fairies section). You cannot cast Fairy Tamer spells while wearing martial armor. You gain the listed Elemental Aspects only if you have summoned a fairy of the appropriate element.

actionCard.name: Summon Fairy
actionCard.description: You may summon, swap out, or dismiss one of your fairies.

actionCard.name: Elemental Infusion
actionCard.description: Give your weapon or an ally's weapon an Infusion with one of the following elements. You must have a fairy of the corresponding element summoned to choose that damage type. You may only have one of these active at a time.

actionCard.name: Spirit Unification
actionCard.description: Combine your hearts and minds with all of your summoned fairies. For the duration you can cast their spells and gain resistance to their corresponding damage types. Their spells deal additional damage equal to your Presence modifier. You gain 10 Barrier for each fairy you combined with.

reactions.name: Fairy's Kiss
reactions.trigger: You or an ally within 3 tiles deals physical damage to a creature
reactions.description: You may have one of your summoned fairies grant them Barrier equal to your Presence modifier. You must have at least one fairy summoned to use this.

reactions.name: Elemental Barrier
reactions.trigger: You are attacked
reactions.description: Gain Resistance to the damage type of the attack for this attack only if you have a fairy summoned of the corresponding element.

fury.name: Fury
fury.description: The Fury is a warrior that faces danger head-on and turns it into strength. They excel at slamming people into and through walls.

focusFeat.name: Adrenaline
focusFeat.description: The first time per round you take damage you gain 1 Focus.

bigHands.name: Big Hands
bigHands.description: You gain a Boon on Grab checks.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.description: If you are Bloodied you deal +2 damage with melee attacks. If you are Bloodied at the start of your turn you may choose to Rage, granting a Boon to all attacks that target only you. In exchange you have a Boon on all attacks you make for the rest of the round.

bluntForceTrauma.name: Juggernaut
bluntForceTrauma.description: When you make an Opportunity Attack with a 2H weapon you can give it Multi(2) but the damage is halved (round up)

fury.freeFeaturesNote: You gain proficiency with martial melee weapons and martial armor. Fury: You're strong enough to jam your weapon into the side of a stone wall to create a small platform to stand on.

actionCard.name: Big Crush
actionCard.description: Prepare a big overhead strike. You cannot take Reactions while the Delay effect is pending, but you are also unaffected by forced movement. If any creature tries to move out of melee range and would normally trigger an Opportunity attack but the Delay effect has yet to be activated you may instead immediately activate the Delay effect and remove it afterwards.

actionCard.name: Yeet
actionCard.description: If a creature is currently Grabbed by you then you can throw them, using them as a projectile. This is considered a push for the thrown creature and the distance thrown is the range. This is affected by the thrown creature's stability. If the thrown creature's size is greater than 1L this deals bonus damage equal to the creature's size. Both the thrown creature and any creature that the thrown creature hits take damage.

actionCard.name: Get Over Here
actionCard.description: Drag your target over to you

actionCard.name: Wild Rush
actionCard.description: Stride up to your Speed before attacking the target. You must move at least 3 tiles. Your Defense is reduced by 2 until the start of your next turn.

actionCard.name: Mighty Leap
actionCard.description: Choose an unoccupied tile within tiles equal to your Speed. You jump high in the air and land on that tile by warping to it, releasing a powerful shockwave around you that affects all creatures within 1 tile, dealing crushing damage. Deal bonus damage equal to the stability of any creature you have Grabbed

actionCard.name: Eye for an Eye
actionCard.description: Prepare a powerful attack. If you take any damage before the delay effect triggers then you may add your Might modifier to the damage and stride up to half your Speed (round down) when the delay effect triggers. Once the delay effect triggers you may attack

actionCard.name: Power Smash
actionCard.description: Unleash a single focused blow that sends your enemy flying

actionCard.name: Roundhouse
actionCard.description: Prepare to swing in a circle around you, hitting all creatures within range of your weapon

actionCard.name: Armorsplitter
actionCard.description: Unleash a downward swing intended to damage your opponent's armor

actionCard.name: Soul Ripper
actionCard.description: Attack the target. If you have a Bond towards them you may recover 5 HP and 3 Mana afterwards. Cannot be used on allies.

actionCard.name: Earthcleaver
actionCard.description: Split the earth, dealing damage in a 5x1 line starting from you and leaving the area as difficult terrain. Each creature in the area receives push 2 away from the line.

actionCard.name: Meteor Tackle
actionCard.description: Inflict push 7 on yourself, ignoring stability, in any direction you want. If you slam into a creature after moving at least 1 tiles you do not take damage but instead inflict the remaining push onto the creature, moving along with them in the adjacent tile.

actionCard.name: Hatred
actionCard.description: Sacrifice the greater of either 3 times your Presence modifier or 3 HP. Then attack your target, increasing the damage dealt by the sacrificed HP. This attack has an innate Dark infusion that cannot be overridden.

reactions.name: Stand Your Ground
reactions.trigger: You receive forced movement
reactions.description: Temporarily increase your Stability by 1 for that forced movement only

reactions.name: Unstoppable
reactions.trigger: You take damage from a hostile creature while already Bloodied
reactions.description:
Choose one of the following

 -Restore 2 times your Might modifier HP

 -Restore Might modifier MP

 -End one status effect on yourself.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: Guardians are dedicated to protecting their friends by tanking damage for them.

focusFeat.name: Watch Out
focusFeat.description: The first time per round an ally loses HP you gain 1 Focus.

shieldMaster.name: Shield Master
shieldMaster.description: You may equip shields in both hands and use them as weapons. Use half of your shield's defense (round up) in place of weapon damage with the damage being crushing. If you have shields equipped in both hands then you can use the full shield defense value instead and the damage from your Opportunity Attacks is doubled. You may increase the damage dealt by attacks with your shield by this amount. Reduce the Might requirement to equip tower shields by 1. The Stability bonus from shields do not stack.

bigBarriers.name: Big Barriers
bigBarriers.description: When granting Barrier you can increase the barrier amount by your shield's defense if you have one equipped.

centerOfGravity.name: Center of Gravity
centerOfGravity.description: Gain 1 Stability. The movement cost of leaving your melee range for hostile creatures is increased by 1 for them. If an ally is about to receive fall damage within 1 tile of you you may also catch them as a free reaction, reducing damage to 0.

elementalTraining.name: Elemental Training
elementalTraining.description: Choose one damage type that is not crushing, slashing, or piercing. You gain resistance to that damage type.

guardian.freeFeaturesNote: You gain proficiency with martial melee weapons, martial armor, and martial shields. Guardian: You can easily detect killing intent.

actionCard.name: Brace for Impact
actionCard.description: You cannot willingly move for the rest of the round. You are treated as an object for the sake of cover and gain 1 Stability. Gain 5 Barrier

actionCard.name: Come at Me
actionCard.description: Unleash a battle cry, taunting nearby enemies within 3 tiles.

actionCard.name: Shield Bash
actionCard.description: If you have a shield equipped you can bash them with it, dealing crushing damage. You can shift 1 afterwards. This can be used without a target to only shift.

actionCard.name: Shield Tackle
actionCard.description: If you have a shield equipped you can shift up to your Speed in a straight line and slam into them with it, dealing crushing damage. You must shift at least 3 tiles. You gain the effects of your corresponding Raise Shield or Quick Block.

actionCard.name: Hammering Blows
actionCard.description: This can only be used if you have 2 shields equipped. Use one of your shields to hammer your other shield into the target, dealing slashing damage.

actionCard.name: Shield Bounce
actionCard.description: Throw your shield at a target to deal crushing damage and have it bounce to another target before returning to you and re-equipping automatically. This shield cannot have the Heavy tag.

actionCard.name: Fortress
actionCard.description: Grant some of your allies Barrier.

actionCard.name: Sacrifical Bond
actionCard.description: Choose an adjacent ally. Until the end of the round they gain resistance to all damage types and you gain Vulnerability (X) to all damage types. The vulnerability amount depends on your success tier.

actionCard.name: Crown of Thorns
actionCard.description: Surround yourself with a prickly aura. Each time you are attacked with a melee attack the attacker loses HP equal to your Stability.

actionCard.name: Shockwave
actionCard.description: Release a shockwave that deals magical crushing damage to all hostile creatures in range. Remove all Barrier on yourself, increasing the damage half of the removed amount (round up).

actionCard.name: Enforced Duel
actionCard.description: Choose a target in range. A single magical barrier surrounds the both of you with the durability of metal. It does not prevent attacks from coming in or out, but it does block movement of any kind while it lasts. Neither of you can leave the barrier for the duration or until one of you is killed.

actionCard.name: Deflective Shield
actionCard.description: Can only be used while you have a shield equipped. For the rest of the round all non-Area ranged attacks deflect off of you, reducing their damage by up to 10 and inflicting that reduced amount as damage back at the attacker for the same amount and type. Other effects like forced movement are not blocked however.

actionCard.name: Spin to Win
actionCard.description: Spin in a circle, releasing a powerful gale that cycles in a 2 tile radius around you. All creatures in the area are Slowed except you while they remain in the area. If you move from your location the gale ends.

reactions.name: Reactive Shield
reactions.trigger: You are about to be attacked
reactions.description: You raise your shield, gaining its defense bonus until the start of your next turn.

reactions.name: Castle
reactions.trigger: An adjacent ally is attacked by a hostile creature
reactions.description: Swap places with the ally and take that attack for them

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.description: Marksman are experts at dealing physical damage from a distance.

focusFeat.name: Battle Sense (Ranged)
focusFeat.description: The first time per round an enemy takes damage from a ranged attack you gain 1 Focus.

platformStability.name: Platform Stability
platformStability.description: If you have not changed positions since the beginning of the round your ranged attacks deal +2 damage.

throwingArt.name: Throwing Art
throwingArt.description: If attacking by throwing a weapon or object you may spend 1 Focus if you are dual-wielding throwable objects to throw both and grant the attack Repeat(2)

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.description: Can add multi (2) to ranged weapon attack by spending 5 mana. If it already has multi (2) change it to multi (3). This attack cannot have Delay.

skilledSniper.name: Skilled Sniper
skilledSniper.description: Hitting a creature at least 8 tiles away with a ranged weapon attack grants Penetrate (2) for that attack

marksman.freeFeaturesNote: You gain proficiency with martial ranged weapons and martial shields. Marksman: You recognize almost all melee weapons used by almost any creature as well as most non-firearm ammo.

actionCard.name: Multishot
actionCard.description: Fire 2 shots simultaneously

actionCard.name: Make it Rain
actionCard.description: Fire a rain of projectiles that land after a delay in a 3x3 area.

actionCard.name: Steady Aim
actionCard.description: Aim carefully at a target. Your next ranged attack on that target this turn ignores cover.

actionCard.name: Throw
actionCard.description: Throw a weapon with the Throwing tag at the target. You do not lose weapons after throwing them. Treat it as if you had more of those weapons or the weapon came back.

actionCard.name: Quickdraw
actionCard.description: Quickly draw your weapon and fire a shot. This can only be used once per combat.

actionCard.name: Smoke Shot
actionCard.description: Fire a special shot whose end is a rounded ball filled with smokepowder

actionCard.name: Snipe
actionCard.description: Prepare a powerful shot at a single target. If your position changes before the Delay effect triggers then this attack gains double Bane.

actionCard.name: Piercing Shot
actionCard.description: Fire a shot in a straight 10x1 line starting from you.

actionCard.name: Pinning Shot
actionCard.description: Fire a shot aimed near the target's legs to stop them in their tracks.

actionCard.name: Explosive Shot
actionCard.description: Fire an explosive shot that trades damage for knockback

actionCard.name: Fan Fire
actionCard.description: Fire several attacks simultaneously

actionCard.name: Lockdown
actionCard.description: Choose a 5x5 area. If any hostile creature in that area shifts without cover or strides you immediately take a shot at them as a free reaction. Roll once total.

actionCard.name: Homing Shots
actionCard.description: Fire several shots into the air that will home onto your target, ignoring the effects of cover. Even if the target leaves your line of sight after use the attack will still hit as long as there is a traversable path in the air for the attacks to move through.

reactions.name: Warden's Shot
reactions.trigger: A hostile creature starts an action with a Delay tag
reactions.description: Fire a Warden's Shot at them

actionCard.name: Warden's Shot
actionCard.description: Fire a Warden's Shot at them

reactions.name: Crossfire
reactions.trigger: A hostile creature targets an ally within 10 tiles with a ranged attack
reactions.description: You have Crossfire charges equal to your Dexterity modifier. You may spend one of these charges to decrease the success tier of that ranged attack by 1. Doesn't work against critical hits. Charges reset at the end of combat.

priest.name: Priest
priest.description: Priests get their power from their faith and worship of gods or other divine beings.

focusFeat.name: Great Empathy
focusFeat.description: If you start your turn within 5 tiles of an injured ally you gain 1 Focus.

rewardForFaith.name: Reward for Faith
rewardForFaith.description: If you have an Implement weapon equipped and no martial armor equipped when casting you can add that weapon's damage to the healing or barrier amount of your spells if their AP cost is at least 2.

therapist.name: Therapist
therapist.description: When targeting allies with a spell while having an Implement weapon equipped, if you have a bond with one of them you may select one of the ones you have a Bond with and spend 2 Focus to grant them a Boon on their next Power Roll.

deityBoon.name: Deity Boon
deityBoon.description: At level 3 you gain the passive granted by your chosen deity (full text appears when you select a deity).

tearsOfBlood.name: Tears of Blood
tearsOfBlood.description: If mana is insufficient to cast a spell targeting only allies you can spend HP instead for twice the cost. If the spell would heal you then you don't heal.

deities.name: Sinir
deities.description: Goddess of magic and knowledge; child of Antioch. Her followers spread knowledge. Holy site: the Grant Library.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.description: After healing an ally or granting them barrier you also restore 2 Mana to them.

deities.name: Lokrus
deities.description: God of war and patron of humans; child of Antioch. Followers believe in mandatory military service. Holy site: the Lokrus Coliseum.

blitzkrieg.name: Blitzkrieg
blitzkrieg.description: When you cast a spell that only targets allies you may remove the Weakened or Slowed effect from them.

deities.name: Branulla
deities.description: Goddess of wealth; child of Antioch. Holy site: the Grand Exchange.

interest.name: Interest
interest.description: If you cast a spell that heals or grants barrier while you are not Bloodied or Dying the amount is increased by 10% of your maximum HP (round down).

deities.name: Uros
deities.description: God of death; child of Ephesus. Bodies should be buried for undeath, not cremated.

foulLegacy.name: Foul Legacy
foulLegacy.description: Most Undead are not automatically hostile towards you.

deities.name: Phara
deities.description: Goddess of souls; child of Ephesus. Undead should be purged. Holy site: the Divine Basilica.

deathPerception.name: Death Perception
deathPerception.description: You ignore the Concealed effect that protects Undead.

deities.name: Atris
deities.description: God of nature; child of Urkesh, parent of Etar and Melios. For every tree or fruit taken, plant anew within 24 hours.

friendOfNature.name: Friend of Nature
friendOfNature.description: Gain one Boon on skill rolls for Animal Handling or Nature.

deities.name: Eyja
deities.description: Goddess of water and patron of elves; child of Urkesh. Holy site: the Deep Water Temple.

watersOrigin.name: Water's Origin
watersOrigin.description: During combat if you are at least half submerged in water you regain 3 HP and Mana at the start of your turn.

deities.name: Torphon
deities.description: God of crafting and patron of dwarves; child of Urkesh. Holy site: the Hall of Gold.

earthsBounty.name: Earth's Bounty
earthsBounty.description: Once per long rest if you are outside of combat you may request your god for some supplies, restoring all your IP.

deities.name: Nera
deities.description: Goddess of love and beauty and patron of the Fayar; child of Sinir. Followers wear a Velia in public.

glamour.name: Glamour
glamour.description: 5 times per long rest you may change your appearance at will.

deities.name: Etar
deities.description: God of hunting and patron of the Gradia; child of Atris. Shares the Egg of Life with Melios.

woundLicking.name: Wound Licking
woundLicking.description: If an ally within 3 tiles takes damage from an Opportunity attack you can reduce the damage by 3 and take that damage instead.

deities.name: Melios
deities.description: God of the sun and patron of the Florians; child of Atris. Shares the Egg of Life with Etar.

miniatureSun.name: Miniature Sun
miniatureSun.description: Twice per long rest you can create a small glowing orb that emits bright light for up to 8 hours, shining up to 8 tiles away. This orb follows you.

priest.freeFeaturesNote: You may seek aid from religious institutions. You must choose a deity; that deity grants additional class talents (shown when selected). You gain Light and Dark elemental aspects for your spells where applicable.

actionCard.name: Quick Heal
actionCard.description: Utter a few words as you heal an ally

actionCard.name: Double Heal
actionCard.description: Release a surge of healing on two targets.

tier2Effect.effect: End one status effect on each target

tier3Effect.effect: End two status effects on each target

actionCard.name: Bless
actionCard.description: Grant all allies within 3 tiles Barrier for 1 minute.

tier3Effect.effect: End one status effect on one of the targets

actionCard.name: Prism
actionCard.description: Deals light damage

actionCard.name: Chain Heal
actionCard.description: Release a surge of healing that bounces to other targets

actionCard.name: Divine Infusion
actionCard.description: Choose one of your or an ally's weapon. Give it either Infusion (Light) or Infusion (Dark). You can only have one of these at a time.

actionCard.name: Repel Undead
actionCard.description: This spell only affects Undead. Release a force of divine power against all undead within 3 tiles of you, dealing light damage.

actionCard.name: Divine Aura
actionCard.description:
You unleash a powerful aura around yourself for the duration. All allies that stay within 3 tiles of you gain +1 to all their Potency Checks to resist a hostile creature's effects.

Maintain: During the start phase you may spend 1 Focus and 8 Mana to maintain this ability. If you do so then you can retrigger the ability.

actionCard.name: Cleansing Light
actionCard.description: Empower an ally's weapon. They deal an extra 2 damage to Corrupted. You may only have one of these active at a time.

actionCard.name: Defibrillator
actionCard.description: Choose a party member that has died this combat. You may spare them from death, setting their HP to the amount specified by the success tier. They may act on the next round of combat. The mana cost of this spell doubles after each use, resetting at the start of combat. You may also use this spell on a previously slain party member if no more than 1 minute has passed after their death.

actionCard.name: Regeneration
actionCard.description: Heal the target. If the target is Bloodied increase the healing amount by 10. Any limbs broken or lost within the last 24 hours are restored.

actionCard.name: Heavenly Shrine
actionCard.description: Sinir: Create a small shrine. If an ally steps on it it heals them and lets them shift 1. If a hostile creature steps on it it disappears. Max 2 shrines. Double the healing amount if it lasts to Start Phase.

actionCard.name: Transfer Mana
actionCard.description: Sinir: You may spend as much additional Mana as you want up to the amount you have available. The targets gains that additional mana.

actionCard.name: Night Slash
actionCard.description: Lokrus: Release blades of darkness at your targets to deal dark damage. A roll of 18 is also considered a critical hit for this spell.

actionCard.name: Berserk
actionCard.description: Lokrus: Choose a willing target. The creature becomes berserk, gaining a Boon on their attack rolls and gaining Penetrate (3). However they lose 5 Def and cannot cast spells.

actionCard.name: Blood Loan
actionCard.description: Branulla: Grant the target Barrier immediately. When the Delay effect triggers if the target is Bloodied or Dying they lose HP equal to the Barrier amount.

actionCard.name: Generous Donation
actionCard.description: Branulla: Choose a willing target with less HP than you. You swap HP with them. Both HP cannot exceed their maximum. Afterwards both of you are healed.

actionCard.name: Consume
actionCard.description: Uros: Choose a willing target. The creature loses some HP and you regain twice that amount of HP. If the creature's HP is 0 or less as a result of this it dies.

actionCard.name: Living on Edge
actionCard.description: Uros: Choose a willing target. The creature cannot die for the duration. You can only have one creature affected with this spell at a time.

actionCard.name: Smite
actionCard.description: Phara: Empower your next melee attack. If that attack hits an Undead the attack's damage is increased by 8. Otherwise the damage is increased by 5.

actionCard.name: Return to Dust
actionCard.description: Phara: This spell only affects Undead. All Undead of a lower level than you that are at most Normal-class within 3 tiles are immediately destroyed. All other Undead take light damage.

actionCard.name: Curia
actionCard.description: Eyja: Use water to wash away some status effects

tier1Effect.effect: Remove 1 status effect from the target

tier2Effect.effect: Remove 2 status effect from the target

tier3Effect.effect: Remove 3 status effect from the target

actionCard.name: Soothing Ice Pillar
actionCard.description: Eyja: Create a pillar of ice on an unoccupied tile. It has the durability of wood. All creatures within 1 tile of the pillar are immune to Bleeding and Poisoned.

actionCard.name: Mud Pillar
actionCard.description: Torphon: Create a pillar of mud on an unoccupied tile. It has the durability of wood.

actionCard.name: Crystal Plating
actionCard.description: Torphon: Cover all allies within 5 tiles with crystal armor, granting Barrier. At the Start Phase of the next round all affected allies lose all Barrier.

actionCard.name: Charming Smile
actionCard.description: Nera: Once per long rest you may charm a creature that is not Elite or Boss class for 4 hours. If you choose a hostile creature they must make a Presence saving throw.

tier3Effect.effect: Bane on attacks against you for the duration of combat

actionCard.name: Intensity
actionCard.description: Nera: Heal the target. If you have a Bond of Affection or Hatred with the target you may first remove one status effect and also grant the same amount healed as a Barrier. If you don't have a Bond with them you may add one afterwards.

actionCard.name: Nature Ward
actionCard.description: Etar: Create 3 rings of magical leaves that orbit around the target. The next 3 times the target take damage one ring will automatically decrease the damage by 3, disappearing afterwards.

actionCard.name: Camouflage
actionCard.description: Etar: You release an magical aura around you that makes all allies invisible for the duration so long as they remain within 3 tiles of you. The spell ends if you or any affected ally takes 8 or more damage in one turn. If used outside of combat the duration is 1 minute but ends if you enter combat.

actionCard.name: Sunbeam
actionCard.description: Melios: Fire a beam of concentrated light, dealing light damage

actionCard.name: Revealing Light
actionCard.description: Melios: Select a 3x3 area to be illuminated by whitish-blue light. All Concealed creatures in the area lose their Concealed status. Removes magical darkness. All allies in the area are cleansed of one status effect.

actionCard.name: Thorn Whipper
actionCard.description: Atris: Grow a Thorn Whipper in an unoccupied tile. It has a melee range of 2 and 1 HP. If it suffers forced movement it dies. Hostile creatures that enter or exit its range trigger its Opportunity Attack that deals 2 damage. You can only have one of these created at a time.

actionCard.name: Sacred Flowers
actionCard.description:
Atris: Create a field of flowers in a 5x5 area in range. All creatures in the area regenerate 6 HP during the End Phase.

Maintain: During the start phase you may spend 1 Focus and 8 Mana to maintain this ability.

reactions.name: Vigilant
reactions.trigger: An attack against an ally within 10 tiles afflicts them with Bleeding, Slowed, Frightened, or Poisoned.
reactions.description: Cancel the status effect before it applies

reactions.name: Sanctuary
reactions.trigger: An ally is about to receive magic damage
reactions.description: Reduce that magical damage by 5.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: The Scout excels at sneaking and mobility.

focusFeat.name: High-Speed Combat
focusFeat.description: The first time per round you or a hostile creature strides, shifts, or warps you gain 1 Focus.

backpacker.name: Backpacker
backpacker.description: Once per combat you may use an Interact action to target an adjacent ally. If you do so you allow them to immediately spend 1 Respite.

forage.name: Forage
forage.description: Whenever you take a Short Rest and spend at least one Respite or travel over long distances in habitable locations you may take the Forage option to restore some IP. Make a Willpower Roll

backstep.name: Backstep
backstep.description: When you take the Disengage action you may shift 2 tiles instead of stride 1. You may also Disengage for only 1 AP instead of 2 AP.

scout.freeFeaturesNote: Scout: You can spin pencils and similar objects easily with one hand.

actionCard.name: Blitz
actionCard.description: You may immediately shift up to your Speed to an an unoccupied tile adjacent to a hostile creature and attack them with your weapon. If you are not wearing martial armor you may warp up to twice your Speed instead

actionCard.name: Steal
actionCard.description: Attempt to steal something from an adjacent normal-class enemy. You may only steal from each such enemy once per combat.

actionCard.name: Poison Needles
actionCard.description: Throw poisoned needles at your target

actionCard.name: Caltrop Deployment
actionCard.description: Drop caltrops in a 3x3 area. That area is now difficult terrain.

actionCard.name: Swipe
actionCard.description: Quickly swing your weapon with a quick swipe

actionCard.name: Hit and Run
actionCard.description: You may Stride up to your Speed as part of this action. Strike a target with your weapon.

actionCard.name: Assassinate
actionCard.description: Target your foes weak spots. If the target currently has a status effect or you have a Boon on this attack then this attack gains Penetrate (5).

actionCard.name: Hookshot
actionCard.description: Throw a grappling hook and jump, pulling yourself to a new location. Warp up to your Speed. Alternatively you can use this on a friendly creature of your size or smaller to pull 2 towards you instead.

actionCard.name: Flashbang
actionCard.description: Throw a flashbang that emits bright light and sound in a 2x2 area.

actionCard.name: Cross Slash
actionCard.description: You may stride 1 towards your target as part of this attack. If you are dual wielding this deals an extra 2 damage.

actionCard.name: Vanishing Strike
actionCard.description: Strike the target, turn invisible for until the End Phase of the next round, and then shift 2.

actionCard.name: Lightning Steps
actionCard.description: Warp up to 2 times your Speed to an an unoccupied tile. If there are any hostile creatures between your original location and destination you may choose one of them to deal damage to on the way with your weapon. Normal-class enemies are killed automatically.

actionCard.name: Monowire
actionCard.description: Choose an adjacent sturdy object like a wall or pillar and another such object within 3 tiles. Deploy a very thin wire between both objects. Any hostile creature that enters the area, willingly or not, takes 5 slashing damage with Penetrate (3).

reactions.name: Follow-Up Attack
reactions.trigger: An ally besides you damages a hostile creature reachable within 3 tiles
reactions.description: If you have a 1H melee weapon equipped and are not wearing martial armor then you may shift 3 to any tile that puts them in your melee range. You must then make an Opportunity Attack on them.

reactions.name: Evasion
reactions.trigger: You are attacked and your Speed is at least 1
reactions.description: You gain Evasion charges equal to your Dexterity modifier. You may spend an Evasion charge to reduce the success tier of the attack by 1 and decrease damage by 2 only against you and shift 3 after the attack completes. Your Evasion charges reset at the end of combat.

sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
sorcerer.description: Users of the magical arts, Sorcerers are experts at dealing magical damage to many enemies in strong bursts.

focusFeat.name: Ambient Mana
focusFeat.description: The first time per round an enemy takes magic damage you gain 1 Focus

manaRecycling.name: Mana Recycling
manaRecycling.description: If the Delay effect of one of your actions activates but nobody is affected by it you may refund yourself half of the mana cost (round down).

arcaneTradition.name: Arcane Tradition
arcaneTradition.description: If you have an Implement weapon equipped and no martial armor equipped when casting you can add that weapon's damage to the damage of your spells if their AP cost is at least 2

twinCast.name: Twincast
twinCast.description: Can add multi (2) to a non-Delay and non-Area ranged spell attack by doubling the mana cost. If it already has multi (2) change it to multi (3).

carefulCasting.name: Careful Casting
carefulCasting.description: Your Area spells deal half damage (round up) to allies

actionCard.name: Mana Sphere
actionCard.description: Unleash a blast of pure mana, dealing magical crushing damage

actionCard.name: Flame Pillar
actionCard.description:
Prepare to unleash columns of flames in a 3x3 area that reach 5 tiles high, dealing fire damage

Maintain: During the start phase you may spend 1 Focus and 10 Mana to maintain this ability. If you do so then you can retrigger the ability in the same area during the End Phase.

actionCard.name: Icicle Lance
actionCard.description: Launch two sharp icicles at multiple targets, dealing water damage

actionCard.name: Volatile Bubble
actionCard.description: Create a bubble at your current location that stays there until the Delay effect triggers. It drifts towards the target and deals water damage.

actionCard.name: Wind Cutter
actionCard.description: Unleash slicing wind blades at the target to deal air damage

actionCard.name: Acid Splash
actionCard.description: Launch acid at some nearby enemies to deal nature damage

actionCard.name: Fireball
actionCard.description: Target a creature. Charge up a powerful concentration of flames that explodes in a 3x3 area once it hits its target dealing fire damage to all creatures in the area. The target is pushed away from the caster, but other creatures in the area are pushed away from the target. If you take at least 10 damage in one turn the explosive orb explodes prematurely on your location. After the attack flames remain in the area for 1 minute

actionCard.name: Shadow Spears
actionCard.description: Several large shadowy spears erupt around the target, impaling them to deal dark damage

actionCard.name: Blazing Solis
actionCard.description: Unleash a powerful beam of light in a 3x15 line starting from you. Each creature in the area takes light damage.

actionCard.name: Stone Cannon
actionCard.description: Compress several rocks together before blasting them at your target to deal earth damage

actionCard.name: Geyser
actionCard.description: Boiling water bursts from the ground in a 3x3 area, reaching up to 10 tiles high, to deal water damage

actionCard.name: Energy Javelins
actionCard.description:
Select some targets you can see. Prepare to rain a volley of glowing javelins onto the selected targets that appear 10 tiles above them. There must be sufficient vertical overhead for the spell.

Maintain: During the Start phase you may spend 3 Focus and 10 Mana to maintain this ability. If you do so then you can retrigger the ability in the same area during the End Phase.

actionCard.name: Lightning Blast
actionCard.description: Release a bolt of lightning to deal volt damage

reactions.name: Paired Casting
reactions.trigger: An ally that you can see casts an attack spell that targets an enemy
reactions.description: You can increase the damage dealt by an amount equal to your Reason modifier

reactions.name: Return Fire
reactions.trigger: You are attacked by a ranged attack
reactions.description: After you are attacked by a ranged attack you may fire back at the attacker with Flare Arrow to deal fire damage:

actionCard.name: Flare Arrow
actionCard.description: After you are attacked by a ranged attack you may fire back at the attacker with Flare Arrow to deal fire damage:

tactician.name: Tactician
tactician.description: Tacticians control the battle, offering utility and other buffs to control the situation.

focusFeat.name: Prioritization
focusFeat.description: The first time per round the creature you marked takes damage you gain 1 Focus.

knowledgeIsPower.name: Knowledge is Power
knowledgeIsPower.description: When you take the Study action to learn a trait about a target you automatically gain the Skill bonus if you have the appropriate skill already without spending Inspiration. You gain one additional trained skill from Interpersonal or Lore (choose in character creation).

goodMemory.name: Good Memory
goodMemory.description: You have very good memory of events that have happened in the past week. 3 times per long Rest you may request specific information from the DM regarding something your character may have noticed at the time but that you the player or player character may not remember currently such as the color of a shopkeeper's earrings.

grizzledExperience.name: Grizzled Experience
grizzledExperience.description: Increase your max Mana by 5 and gain Immunity to the Frightened condition

caughtOut.name: Caught Out
caughtOut.description: During the Start Phase of the first round of combat you may immediately use Mark on a target and then slide them up to 3 tiles, ignoring stability. This movement cannot cause them to take damage (such as falling off a ledge), kill them, or cause them to suffer any status conditions or negative effects.

tactician.freeFeaturesNote: You gain proficiency with martial melee weapons and martial ranged weapons. Tactician: You are surprisingly adept at strategy games and can identify tactical opportunities before combat if you have time to prepare and notice them.

actionCard.name: Mark
actionCard.description: Mark a target. The mark lasts until you are dying, dead, or until you use this again. Only one Mark can exist on a creature at a time and if another Mark ability is used on one that already has Mark then the new one replaces the old one. If the marked target dies then you may spend a free Reaction to mark a new target in range. As long as you have line of sight to the marked creature all allies gain a Boon on Power Rolls made against that creature.

actionCard.name: Battle Cry
actionCard.description: Release a battle cry to encourage your allies within 8 tiles. They deal additional damage this round equal to half your Presence modifier (round up)

actionCard.name: Reposition
actionCard.description: Choose some allies within range. As a free Reaction all of them and you can shift up to your respective Speeds.

actionCard.name: Switch  Targets
actionCard.description: If you have already marked a creature then the mark switches to the new target before you attack them.

actionCard.name: Bait and Switch
actionCard.description: Strike the target with your weapon and then shift 1. Afterwards one of your allies within 3 tiles can shift 2.

actionCard.name: I got you
actionCard.description: You and all adjacent allies gain Stability equal to your half your Presence modifier (round up, min 1)

actionCard.name: Strike Now
actionCard.description:
Choose an ally within range. They can immediately make an attack that costs up to 2 AP as a free Reaction.

5 Focus: Select an additional ally

actionCard.name: Now's your chance
actionCard.description: Choose a target. All allies within 2 tiles of the target can make an Opportunity attack against them as free Reaction. They can use a ranged Opportunity Attack instead with a ranged weapon using half weapon damage (round up)

actionCard.name: Take a Breather
actionCard.description: You strike a target to distract them, giving you team time to recover. You and all allies adjacent to the target gain 6 Barrier

actionCard.name: Advanced Targeting
actionCard.description: Choose some un-marked targets. They are now Marked. If an ally attacks a Marked target with a non-Area attack that doesn't have Multi you may spend 1 Focus to add Multi (2) to it

actionCard.name: Fine, I'll do it myself
actionCard.description: The target must be marked by you. Attack them with your weapon. Remove the mark afterwards.

actionCard.name: Mind Games
actionCard.description: You cause your enemies to panic and become uncoordinated. You may only select Normal-class enemies or below. You can slide all targets. If a target is force moved into another creature the target must make an Opportunity attack against that other creature. A target can only use one Opportunity attack this way.

actionCard.name: Killing Time
actionCard.description: Whenever an ally kills a creature marked by you they may immediately shift 2.

reactions.name: Trigger Mark
reactions.trigger: The target you marked takes damage from an ally
reactions.description: You can increase the damage dealt by half your Presence modifier (round up).

reactions.name: Tactical Retreat
reactions.trigger: A hostile creature uses a Delay action
reactions.description: Allow one of your allies targeted by it or in its area of effect to immediately shift 2.

weaponmaster.name: Weaponmaster
weaponmaster.description: Weaponmasters are those who have spent a significant amount of time and effort honing their craft with their weapon. This can be either several weapons or a single one.

focusFeat.name: Battle Sense (Melee)
focusFeat.description: The first time per round an enemy takes damage from a melee attack you gain 1 Focus

weaponBond.name: Weapon Bond
weaponBond.description: Choose a melee weapon you are wielding. You bond to that weapon. Once per combat you can ignore one Bane on an attack using this weapon. You can change your bonded weapon after a Long Rest.

bladestorm.name: Bladestorm
bladestorm.description: Can add multi (2) to melee attack by spending 5 mana. If it already has multi (2) change it to multi (3). This attack cannot have Delay.

exploitWeakness.name: Exploit Weakness
exploitWeakness.description: The minimum damage for a melee physical attack that you add weapon damage to is 2.

focusedStrikes.name: Focused Strikes
focusedStrikes.description: You may convert all your Multi on a melee weapon attack to Repeat instead by spending 1 Focus.

actionCard.name: Honed Strike
actionCard.description: Strike forward with precision

actionCard.name: Wide Swing
actionCard.description: Release a wide swing to hit multiple enemies

actionCard.name: Pommel Strike
actionCard.description: Smack them with a blunt part of your weapon. The damage type is changed to Crushing.

actionCard.name: Parting Slash
actionCard.description: Attack a target and then shift 2. You must hit a target to use this.

actionCard.name: Twin Strike
actionCard.description: Attack your target. If this is not your first attack on the target this round then this gains a Boon.

actionCard.name: Sweeper
actionCard.description: Shift 1 and swing your weapon at your target. If their shield is raised before damage applies then the shield is brought down before calculating damage

actionCard.name: Mutilate
actionCard.description: Target your foe's weak spots

actionCard.name: Charge
actionCard.description: Your Speed increases by 2 for this attack. Shift up to your Speed in a straight line before attacking the target. You must shift at least 3 tiles.

actionCard.name: Disarming Strike
actionCard.description: Try to weaken you foe's grip on their weapons as you hit them

actionCard.name: Foresight Slash
actionCard.description: Enter a defensive stance where you cannot make Opportunity attacks. Gain 5 Barrier. If you are attacked before the Delay effect triggers then after the attack is resolved you may shift up to your Speed and attack a target. If the Delay effect triggers and you have not been attacked then nothing happens.

actionCard.name: Killing Edge
actionCard.description: Quickly unleash several attacks with your weapon on multiple nearby targets. Your weapon cannot have the Heavy tag.

actionCard.name: Long Thrust
actionCard.description: Thrust in a straight line, dealing damage in a 1xX area extending from you where X is your melee range

actionCard.name: Sword Dance
actionCard.description: You may shift 2 as part of this attack. Unleash an elegant onslaught of attacks on your opponent. If you are using a 1H weapon then you gain 3 Def until the start of your next turn.

reactions.name: Counterattack
reactions.trigger: You take damage from an attack
reactions.description: You may counterattack them with a melee attack. Make an Opportunity Attack against them.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.trigger: You are attacked by a melee attack
reactions.description: You gain Parry charges equal to your Dexterity modifier. You may spend a Parry charge to reduce the incoming damage by 5 as a free Reaction. If you are dual wielding or wielding a 2H weapon you reduce the damage by 6 instead. Your Parry charges reset at the end of combat. You must have a melee weapon equipped.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.description: Master of the arcane arts, Wizards are most concerned with the nature of magic itself rather than finding ways to weaponize it. They offer a wide selection of debuffs while still having some offensive abilities.

focusFeat.name: Honed Mana Sensitivity
focusFeat.description: The first time per round any creature spends Mana you gain 1 Focus.

manaAbsorption.name: Mana Absorption
manaAbsorption.description: After you take damage from an enemy you regain 3 MP.

divination.name: Divination
divination.description: After a Long Rest you may make a Power Roll. Take note of the result. Until your next Long Rest you may replace one of either you or another party member's Power Roll result with the number you rolled. This can be done after they roll but before any effects such as damage are applied.

magicalPressure.name: Magical Pressure
magicalPressure.description: Whenever you deal damage with a spell you may spend additional Mana. The target loses mana equal to half of the additional amount (round down). They cannot go into negative mana.

levitation.name: Levitation
levitation.description: Twice per long rest you may spend 5 Mana to begin flying, granting yourself Flight Speed equal to your Willpower modifier. This has a Maintain effect and costs 3 Mana to maintain. You may also move small objects that are not held or worn at a similar speed.

wizard.freeFeaturesNote: You can perceive Metaphysical beings. Wizard: When interacting with runes or other magical objects you can try to extract information about them (who made them, what they are, when they were made or last activated, etc.). You cannot cast Wizard spells while wearing martial armor. Elemental aspects for your spells: Air, Volt, Dark, Poison.

actionCard.name: Stupefy
actionCard.description: Surround your targets with a purple cloud of numbing spores, inflicting poison damage

actionCard.name: Static Jump
actionCard.description: Release a small burst of electricity that can jump to other targets to deal Volt damage

actionCard.name: Updraft
actionCard.description: Generate a small vortex around your target to deal air damage

actionCard.name: Warp
