actionCard.description: Warp up to your Reason or Willpower modifier to an unoccupied tile

actionCard.name: Imprison
actionCard.description:
Attempt to restrain your target, dealing dark damage. When applying a slow if the target is already slowed then they are restrained instead

5 Focus: This attack gains Repeat(2)

actionCard.name: Magic Circle
actionCard.description: Deploy a magical 2x2 glowing circle on the ground near you. While a creature stands on the magic circle its Power Rolls to cast spells gain a Boon. You may only have one of these active at once and the bonuses do not stack with other magic circles. If you cast this spell while you already have a magic circle deployed the old one disappears and a new one is created.

actionCard.name: Darkness
actionCard.description:
Fill a 5x5 area with magical darkness. All creatures in the area are blinded and other creatures cannot see into or through the area.

- Maintain: You may spend 1 Focus and 5 Mana at the Start Phase to Maintain this spell and keep the field active for this round too.

actionCard.name: Omega Zone
actionCard.description:
Encase a 5x5 area in magical energy. While standing in the area all hostile creatures are afflicted with Sundered. All forced movement effects in this area have their distance reduced by 1.

- Maintain: You may spend 1 Focus and 5 Mana at the Start Phase to Maintain this spell and keep the field active for this round too.

actionCard.name: Spellbreak
actionCard.description: Choose an ongoing magical effect or an ongoing Maintain effect. The owner must make a Willpower Power Roll.

actionCard.name: Frozen Sarcophagus
actionCard.description:
Encases the target in ice, dealing 3 ice damage at the start of their turn while they are restrained.

Maintain: During the Start Phase you can spend 1 Focus and 5 Mana to maintain the effect if they haven't broken out of it.

actionCard.name: Gravity Well
actionCard.description:
Manipulate the forces of gravity in a 5x5 area to deal dark damage to all creatures in the area.

Maintain: You may spend 1 Focus and 5 Mana at the Start Phase to Maintain this spell and retrigger the effect during the End Phase of that round.

actionCard.name: Null Zone
actionCard.description:
Suppress spellcasting in a 5x5 area. No spells can be cast nor mana spent while in this area.

Maintain: You may spend 1 Focus and 8 Mana at the Start Phase to Maintain this spell and keep the field active for this round too.

actionCard.name: Hydro Pump
actionCard.description: Release a powerful blast of water in a 7x3 line starting from you, dealing water damage to all creatures in the area.

reactions.name: Abjuration
reactions.trigger: You are attacked
reactions.description: Throw up a quick magical shield against the attack, reducing the damage by 5.

reactions.name: Subjugate
reactions.trigger: An ally afflicts a hostile creature with Shaken or Dazed
reactions.description: Target them with Subjugate. Subjugate cannot trigger off of other Subjugate reactions and if multiple creatures are affected at the same time you may only choose one target.

actionCard.name: Subjugate
actionCard.description: Subjugate cannot trigger off of other Subjugate reactions and if multiple creatures are affected at the same time you may only choose one target

tier2Effect.effect: Transform Shaken into Dazed. Transform Dazed into Stunned

tier3Effect.effect: Transform Shaken into Dazed. Transform Dazed into Stunned

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description:
Dwarves are a long-living race created by Urkesh for the First War of the Gods, though their patron god has since become Torphon. They have received the fairy blessings of fire and earth which enable them to see fairies and other metaphysical beings. They are known for being friendly, tough, and reliable.

They are characterized by being shorter than humans with an average height of 4 to 4.5 ft. They tend to be stocky, but usually have very large muscles for their size enabling them to perform feats one would not expect of someone their size. Although they don’t mind getting dirty usually, they are usually very careful about keeping their beards clean once they get home and often have a wide range of cleansing and cosmetic products for that purpose.

They are known for having big families with the average family having 4 children.

dwarf_fairysGrace.name: Fairy's Grace
dwarf_fairysGrace.description: You can see fairies and other metaphysical beings

dwarf_stonePsychometry.name: Stone Psychometry
dwarf_stonePsychometry.description: You tell the history of a stone just by touching it and spending 2 MP. This can tell you information like how recently it was moved or touched and events that happened to it.

dwarf_dwarvish.name: Dwarvish
dwarf_dwarvish.description: You are fluent in written and verbal communications in Dwarvish

dwarf_tough.name: Tough
dwarf_tough.description: Your Might modifier gains a +1 bonus only for the sake of resisting Potencies.

dwarf_elementalResistance.name: Elemental Resistance
dwarf_elementalResistance.description: Resist either fire or earth damage

dwarf_proneImmunity.name: Prone Immunity
dwarf_proneImmunity.description: You are immune to the Prone condition

dwarf_vulnerability.name: Vulnerability
dwarf_vulnerability.description: Gain VU (2) to either air, volt, or water damage

elf.name: Elf
elf.description:
Elves are a long-living race created by Urkesh for the First War of the Gods, but their patron god has since become Eyja. They have received the fairy blessings of air and water which enable them to see fairies and other metaphysical beings. They are known for being graceful and intelligent, but also overbearing and pretentious.

They are characterized by being slightly taller than humans and having pointed ears, but otherwise not being too different. Their skin dries easily so they prefer to stay near water.

They usually only have up to 3 children and usually wait at least 50 years between each child to have another one. This is because gestation lasts for almost 2 years. Childbirth is easier though and they usually give birth in water.

elf_fairysGrace.name: Fairy's Grace
elf_fairysGrace.description: You can see fairies and other metaphysical beings

elf_swimmingGrace.name: Swimming Grace
elf_swimmingGrace.description: You can hold your breath underwater for an hour and can speak and understand words normally underwater. You can move as easily underwater as you can on land.

elf_elvish.name: Elvish
elf_elvish.description: You are fluent in written and verbal communications in Elvish

elf_manasight.name: Manasight
elf_manasight.description: You can see through most obscuring effects like smoke or fog. You don't take a bane against concealed creatures

elf_waterWalking.name: Water Walking
elf_waterWalking.description: Twice per long rest you are able to walk on water for 1 minute. Treat it as if you were walking on land. If you fall into the water or fall prone you are knocked into the water.

elf_elementalResistance.name: Elemental Resistance
elf_elementalResistance.description: Resist either air, volt, or water damage

elf_deepMeditation.name: Deep Meditation
elf_deepMeditation.description: Once per long rest you may have one of your respites restore all of your mana instead of half

elf_vulnerability.name: Vulnerability
elf_vulnerability.description: Gain VU (2) to either fire or earth damage

fayar.name: Fayar
fayar.description: The Fayar are a race created by Antioch during the Second War of the Gods, but their patron god has since become Nera. They tend to value hierarchy and martial prowess greatly. They are characterized by having small patches of scales covering parts of their body, impressive horns of various shapes and sizes, and a powerful tail that they can use in combat. They also have wings, but not all Fayar can fly. Otherwise they are fairly similar to humans.

fayar_powerfulTail.name: Powerful tail
fayar_powerfulTail.description: You can use your tail as a Brawling weapon that deals crushing damage. Its damage is 2.

fayar_fayan.name: Fayan
fayar_fayan.description: You are fluent in written and verbal communications in Fayan

fayar_powerfulPresence.name: Powerful Presence
fayar_powerfulPresence.description: Grant an additional +1 bonus when invoking the Intimidation or Persuasion skill

fayar_dragonSight.name: Dragon Sight
fayar_dragonSight.description: You can perceive metaphysical beings. You gain low-light vision.

fayar_flight.name: Flight
fayar_flight.description: Once per long rest you are able to fly for 1 minute. You gain a Flying Speed equal to your Speed.

fayar_spikedTail.name: Spiked Tail
fayar_spikedTail.description: You cannot be flanked and your tail deals piercing damage instead.

fayar_vulnerability.name: Vulnerability
fayar_vulnerability.description: Gain VU (2) to either volt, light, or dark damage

florian.name: Florian
florian.description: Florians are a race created by Urkesh during the Age of Chaos, but their patron god has since become Melios. Although they are unable to see fairies innately they make up for it with their healthy and unique constitution. They are unique in that the type of plant that they represent has a strong correlation with their total lifespan. Flower-like florians often only have a total lifespan of 20 years, while more arboreal florians can have a lifespan of 250 years. They are known for being shy and uncommon. They are characterized by having some plant-like structures on their body such as flowers coming out of their head or bark covering small parts of their body. They have a very wide range in sizes often ranging from 3.5 ft - 6.5 ft.

florian_plantSense.name: Plant sense
florian_plantSense.description: You can tell how plants feel and can talk to them through these feelings. They can share info on things that happened near them recently such as a battle that caused them to be stepped on.

florian_florvish.name: Florvish
florian_florvish.description: You are fluent in written and verbal communications in Florvish

florian_earthlyConnection.name: Earthly connection
florian_earthlyConnection.description: Grant an additional +1 bonus when invoking the Nature or Creature Knowledge skill

florian_photosynthesis.name: Photosynthesis
florian_photosynthesis.description: Once per day if you complete a Short Rest during the daytime in the sun and you spent at least one Respite you can regain 8 HP and 4 MP. This does not stack with the effects of cooking.

gradia.name: Gradia
gradia.description: Gradians are a race created by Urkesh during the Age of Chaos, but their patron god has since become Etar. Although they are unable to see fairies innately they make up for it with their strength and swiftness. They have a short lifespan of only 80 years. They are known for being reserved and unfriendly with strangers, but very close and loyal to their friends. They are characterized by mammalian-like ears and tails in addition to human-like ears. Their height range is similar to humans.

gradia_gradian.name: Gradian
gradia_gradian.description: You are fluent in written and verbal communications in Gradian

gradia_adaptiveSoles.name: Adaptive Soles
gradia_adaptiveSoles.description: You ignore the effects of difficult terrain

gradia_agileReflexes.name: Agile Reflexes
gradia_agileReflexes.description: When you are knocked prone you may spend 1 Focus to instead flip in the air as a free Reaction and land on your feet

gradia_keenSenses.name: Keen Senses
gradia_keenSenses.description: Grant an additional +1 bonus when invoking the Search or Scouting skill. Also gain low-light vision.

gradia_powerfulOrgans.name: Powerful Organs
gradia_powerfulOrgans.description: You succeed on 5 or more for saving throws instead of 6

gradia_vulnerability.name: Vulnerability
gradia_vulnerability.description: Gain VU (1) to air, volt, water, and fire damage.

grassrunner.name: Grassrunner
grassrunner.description: Grassrunners are a mystery. They are short and often mistaken for children and most of them are filled with wanderlust. Although they are rejected by fairies they are not rejected by the gods with some of them allowing grassrunners to become their devout followers and even claiming influential positions in their religious organizations. Nobody knows how they came to this world, including them, but it is suspected that they came from anther world sometime between the Shattering and the end of the Second War of the Gods and simply settled here.

grassrunner_outlander.name: Outlander
grassrunner_outlander.description: You do not have and cannot gain mana. If you are afflicted with a Potency with "save ends" you may treat it as "turn ends" instead.

grassrunner_smallStature.name: Small Stature
grassrunner_smallStature.description: You have a noticeably lower vertical placement in the world. Your size is 1S

grassrunner_chaotic.name: Chaotic
grassrunner_chaotic.description: You are fluent in written and verbal communications in Chaotic

grassrunner_naturalExplorer.name: Natural Explorer
grassrunner_naturalExplorer.description: Grant an additional +1 bonus when invoking the Scouting or Cooking Knowledge skill. Also gain low-light vision.

grassrunner_tacticalRoll.name: Tactical Roll
grassrunner_tacticalRoll.description: You may shift 1 after forced movement is applied onto you as a free Reaction

grassrunner_elementalResistance.name: Elemental Resistance
grassrunner_elementalResistance.description: Gain resistance to either light or dark damage

grassrunner_weakConstitution.name: Weak Constitution
grassrunner_weakConstitution.description: Your Might modifier gains a -1 penalty only for the sake of resisting Potencies.

human.name: Human
human.description:
Humans are one of the most populous race in Coriavela due to their comparatively high fecundity, matched only by some Gradia and the dwarves. They were created by Coriavela as the first race, but Lokrus has since become their patron god. Other races associate them with ambition, greed, bravery, and foolishness.

Although they have a short lifespan of only 100 years their high fecundity is what enables them to maintain population levels and military strength.

human_mundaneSenses.name: Mundane Senses
human_mundaneSenses.description: You can tell if something is magical just by touching it. You cannot use this to perceive fairies or other metaphysical beings.

human_innerSpark.name: Inner Spark
human_innerSpark.description: Expend a charge to give one weapon attack light or dark infusion. Charges refill on a long rest.

human_longHistory.name: Long History
human_longHistory.description: Grant an additional +1 bonus when invoking the Arcana or History skill

human_marchOnward.name: March Onward
human_marchOnward.description: When slowed your Speed is reduced to 3 instead of 2

human_defyFate.name: Defy Fate
human_defyFate.description: Once per long rest you may reroll a Power Roll or saving throw

human_vulnerableMind.name: Vulnerable Mind
human_vulnerableMind.description: Your Willpower modifier gains a -1 penalty only for the sake of resisting Potencies.

wp_fist.name: Fist
wp_fist.description: This represents your hands, feet, or any other tool you use for unarmed strikes

wp_fist_brawler.name: Fist (Brawler)
wp_fist_brawler.description: Only take this if you have taken the corresponding passive in Brawler class. This represents your hands, feet, or any other tool you use for unarmed strikes

wp_robot_tail.name: Robot Tail
wp_robot_tail.description: A mechanical tail that deals crushing damage and can be used for Brawling attacks

wp_potion_launcher.name: Potion Launcher
wp_potion_launcher.description: 2H ranged weapon that fires potions, increasing your potion throwing range to 10. It also acts as an Implement. If there is enough vertical overhead, then the potions may also ignore cover. The potion gains the area effect in a 2x2 area if it didn’t already have it when launched this way. If it already had an area effect then the area increases by 1 in each dimension. So a 2x2 would become a 3x3.

con_healing_potion.name: Healing Potion
con_healing_potion.description: Immediately spend one Respite to restore the equivalent amount of HP

con_mana_potion.name: Mana Potion
con_mana_potion.description: Immediately spend one Respite to restore the equivalent amount of MP

con_antidote.name: Antidote
con_antidote.description: Cures poisoned and bleeding status. You do not take damage in combat from bleeding for the 1 AP you spend to drink this.

con_vial_of_glue.name: Vial of Glue
con_vial_of_glue.description: Creates difficult terrain in a 2x2 area when thrown.

con_vial_of_oil.name: Vial of Oil
con_vial_of_oil.description: Creates flammable oil in a 3x3 area. When subjected to fire it burns for 1 minute.

con_vial_of_poison.name: Vial of Poison
con_vial_of_poison.description:
This is a coating with the following potency that lasts for one attack or 1 minute. It can be added to a weapon:
- No effect
- R < 1 poisoned [round ends]
- R < 2 poisoned [round ends]

con_vial_of_acid.name: Vial of Acid
con_vial_of_acid.description: Creates an acid pit in a 2x2 area when thrown. Acid deals 5 nature damage to any creature that enters the area or is standing in it during the End Phase

con_smokepowder_vial.name: Smokepowder Vial
con_smokepowder_vial.description: Releases smoke in a 3x3 area when throwing, obscuring vision and making all creatures inside Blinded.

con_vial_of_jagged_oil.name: Vial of Jagged Oil
con_vial_of_jagged_oil.description: This is a coating with the following potency that lasts for one attack or 1 minute. It can be added to a weapon.

gear_alchemy_satchel.name: Alchemy Satchel
gear_alchemy_satchel.description: A compact satchel for potions and consumables. Holds up to three consumable items.

gear_extra_large_alchemy_satchel.name: Extra-Large Alchemy Satchel
gear_extra_large_alchemy_satchel.description: A large satchel for potions and consumables. Holds up to 6 consumable items

acc_trap_dispenser_belt.name: Trap Dispenser Belt
acc_trap_dispenser_belt.description: When using actions with the Deployable tag you can do so twice as fast, allowing you to create and deploy twice in the same action by spending twice as much IP.

arm_artificer_armor.name: Artificer's Armor
arm_artificer_armor.description: Modular armor equivalent to chain mail (Defense 4). Bane on Stealth. Configure two invention modules when chosen.

gear_support_backpack.name: Support Backpack
gear_support_backpack.description: A general-purpose support backpack with configurable invention modules. No item capacity limit.

herb_travelers_grass.name: Traveler's Grass
herb_travelers_grass.description: Heals 3 HP. Cannot be used in combat.

herb_heal_root.name: Heal Root
herb_heal_root.description: Heals 8 HP. Cannot be used in combat.

herb_blue_horn_shroom.name: Blue Horn Shroom
herb_blue_horn_shroom.description: Restores 3 Mana. Cannot be used in combat.

herb_golden_clove.name: Golden Clove
herb_golden_clove.description: Restores 8 Mana. Cannot be used in combat.

equipment/raiseShield.name: Raise Shield
equipment/raiseShield.description: Raise your shield to block incoming damage, increasing your Def by the shield's Def value until the start of your next turn. This does not stack.

equipment/quickBlock.name: Quick Block
equipment/quickBlock.description: Raise your shield to block incoming damage, increasing your Def by the shield's Def value until the start of your next turn. This does not stack. You may also shift 2.

equipment/jab.name: Jab
equipment/jab.description: Throw a fast but light punch

equipment/whack.name: Whack
equipment/whack.description: Whack your target with the weapon

equipment/lasso.name: Lasso
equipment/lasso.description: Lasso the target with your weapon

feat/breathAttack.name: Breath Attack
feat/breathAttack.description:
Your animal companion release a breath attack at the target. Choose the damage type when selecting this initially. The damage type does not change afterwards.

- Air

- Water

- Fire

- Earth

feat/waveSwing.name: Wave Swing
feat/waveSwing.description: Requires a melee weapon. Swing your weapon to release a wave at the target. Deals magical damage of the same type as the weapon

feat/bite.name: Bite
feat/bite.description: Your animal companion bites the target to deal piercing damage

feat/scratch.name: Scratch
feat/scratch.description: Your animal companion scratches the target to deal slashing damage

feat/tackle.name: Tackle
feat/tackle.description: Your animal companion tackles the target to deal crushing damage.

feat/protect.name: Protect
feat/protect.description: You have 3 charges of Protect. Expend one to use this free Reaction to have your companion try to block the attack for you to reduce the incoming damage by 3. Once all charges are consumed the companion can no longer be used until after a Short Rest where you spend at least one Respite.

monster/clayFist.name: Clay Fist
monster/clayFist.description: The golem punches the target to deal crushing damage

monster/strawPeck.name: Straw Peck
monster/strawPeck.description: The bird pecks the target to deal piercing damage

monster/snowballToss.name: Snowball Toss
monster/snowballToss.description: The golem throws a snowball to deal 1 water damage

monster/woodFist.name: Wood Fist
monster/woodFist.description: The golem punches the target to deal crushing damage

monster/claySword.name: Clay Sword
monster/claySword.description: The golem swings its sword to deal slashing damage

monster/strawFist.name: Straw Fist
monster/strawFist.description: The golem punches the target to deal 2 crushing damage

monster/interception.name: Interception
monster/interception.description: This creature jumps in the way of the attack, reducing its damage by 3, and then dies
monster/interception.trigger: An ally within 1 tile is targeted by a melee attack

monster/rottenCrossbow.name: Rotten Crossbow
monster/rottenCrossbow.description: The skeleton shoots the target to deal piercing damage

monster/possess.name: Possess
monster/possess.description: Target an adjacent creature. They must make a Presence roll to avoid being restrained. You can only restrain one target this way at a time. Your position automatically moves along with theirs, but you cannot move willingly. You may end this on your turn at will.

monster/rottenPunch.name: Rotten Punch
monster/rottenPunch.description: The zombie punches the target to deal 2 crushing damage

monster/filthyMace.name: Filthy Mace
monster/filthyMace.description: The wight swings its mace to deal crushing damage

monster/spectralClaws.name: Spectral Claws
monster/spectralClaws.description: The wraith swings its claws to deal magical slashing damage

monster/magicInterception.name: Magic Interception
monster/magicInterception.description: This creature jumps in the way of the attack, reducing its damage by 3, and then dies
monster/magicInterception.trigger: An ally within 2 tiles is targeted by a magic attack

monster/shoePossession.name: Shoe Possession
monster/shoePossession.description: Take possession of an allied creature's shoes, increasing their Speed by 2. You can only affect one target this way at a time. Your position automatically moves along with theirs, but you cannot move willingly. You may end this on your turn at will.

fairy/gentleCyclone.name: Gentle Cyclone
fairy/gentleCyclone.description: Choose a 3x3 area. Sylph turns into a cyclone in that area, causing all ranged attacks traveling through the edge of the cyclone to have their damage reduced by 5.

fairy/sonicShield.name: Sonic Shield
fairy/sonicShield.description: Sylph releases a burst of air to reduce the damage of an incoming ranged attack, forced movement, or fall damage by 5
fairy/sonicShield.trigger: An ally other than yourself is attacked by a ranged attack

fairy/magnetRail.name: Magnet Rail
fairy/magnetRail.description: Will o wisp turns into a 5x5 area of electricity. Creatures wearing metal armor in the area treat the area as difficult terrain. If you are not wearing metal armor and are standing on the edge then whenever you stride you may instead shift to any other tile on the edge so long as there is a unobstructed path

fairy/shockingGrasp.name: Shocking Grasp
fairy/shockingGrasp.description: Will o wisp charges one of your melee attacks with electricityl; to deal magical Volt damage instead. If used on the surface of a body of water the attack becomes an area attack instead, targeting all creatures within 5 tiles of you, but loses the damage bonus from your weapon.

fairy/earthPillar.name: Earth Pillar
fairy/earthPillar.description:
Gnome creates a pillar of stone that erupts underneath the target dealing earth damage. If the target is pushed then the pillar remains as a 2 tile high and 1 tile wide pillar. If not then the pillars crumbles after the attack. You may also target an unoccupied tile to forgo an attack and only create the pillar.

Focus 3: Gain Multi (3) and increase push by 1

fairy/mudsport.name: Mudsport
fairy/mudsport.description: Gnome transforms into a 7x7 area into mud, making it difficult terrain.

fairy/hornetNest.name: Hornet Nest
fairy/hornetNest.description: Pixie summons hornets to attack your target, dealing nature damage. This attack ignores cover.

fairy/vineWall.name: Vine Wall
fairy/vineWall.description: Pixie transforms into a thick wall of vines in an unoccupied 7x1 area that blocks vision and movement. It has the durability of wood, but is destroyed instantly by fire damage.

fairy/fireWall.name: Fire Wall
fairy/fireWall.description: Salamander transforms into a 5x1 wall of flames. Any creature that passes through the wall or is in the area when it is created take fire damage.

fairy/trailingComet.name: Trailing Comet
fairy/trailingComet.description: Salamander creates 3 orbs of fire that orbit around you, dealing fire damage each time either a hostile creature or you enter within 1 tile of each other, or if there is a hostile creature within 2 tiles of you during the Start Phase. If there are already hostile creatures in range then the damage triggers instantly for each creature and if there are remaining orbs then they still orbit you. One orb disappears on each hit.

fairy/clearSpring.name: Clear Spring
fairy/clearSpring.description: Undine transforms into a large pool of water in a 7x7 area. The water isn't thick enough to impede movement or deal damage, but it does override most existing terrestrial terrain effects in the area

fairy/fog.name: Fog
fairy/fog.description:
Fill a 3x3 area with fog. All creatures in the area are blinded and other creatures cannot see into or through the area.

Maintain: You may spend 1 Focus and 5 Mana at the Start Phase to Maintain this spell and keep the field active for this round too.

fairy/frostField.name: Frost Field
fairy/frostField.description: Sprite creates a sheet of snow and ice across the ground in a 3x3 area affecting each creature in the area. The ice remains until the End Phase and acts as difficult terrain. If the ice touches the surface of any still bodies of water then the ice stretches as far as is reasonable. Each creature currently in the area on cast or that enters the area must make a Dexterity Power Roll.

fairy/snowflakes.name: Snowflakes
fairy/snowflakes.description: Sprite ascends into the sky and transforms, causing it to snow and lowering the temperature. Cannot be used without access to the sky. All attacks that deal fire damage or have fire infusion have a Bane.

fairy/clearSkies.name: Clear Skies
fairy/clearSkies.description: Flugel ascends into the sky and transforms, eliminating and preventing most weather effects for the duration.

fairy/vacuumSeal.name: Vacuum Seal
fairy/vacuumSeal.description: Flugel temporarily stops the air near a target, ending any magical Maintain effect upheld by the target. This deals air damage.

fairy/thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
fairy/thunderstorm.description: Unicorn ascends into the sky and transforms, creating a thunderstorm. At the start of the round lightning strikes, targeting the creature with the highest elevation and then size in that order to deal volt damage. On ties you decide. You must have access to the sky.

fairy/magnetRise.name: Magnet Rise
fairy/magnetRise.description:
Unicorn uses magnetism to let you levitate off the ground this round, granting you Hover speed equal to your Speed, but you must stay within 1 tile of the ground
Maintain: During the start phase you may pay 1 Focus and 1 mana to continue levitating this round

fairy/shiftingEarth.name: Shifting Earth
fairy/shiftingEarth.description: Gargoyle causes the ground underneath your targets to move, bringing anyone standing on them along with it.

fairy/collapse.name: Collapse
fairy/collapse.description: Create a 2x1 stone pillar on an unoccupied tile in range. Choose up to 5 created pillars of size no more than 3x1. Gargoyle causes each one to collapse in one direction in a 2x1 area adjacent to the pillar, forcing each creature in the area to make a Might Power Roll and take the corresponding crushing damage. They can only take damage from one pillar. The pillars are destroyed afterwards, but leave difficult terrain in the collapsed areas

fairy/leafStorm.name: Leaf Storm
fairy/leafStorm.description:
Dryad transforms into a cyclone of magical leaves in a 3x3 area, dealing nature damage.

Maintain: You may spend 1 Focus and 8 Mana at the Start Phase to Maintain this spell and move the area over up to 2 tiles. Any creature that ends its turn in the area takes the same damage again.

fairy/gigaDrain.name: Giga Drain
fairy/gigaDrain.description: Dryad absorbs energy from your target to deal nature damage, healing you equal to half the damage dealt (round up).

fairy/lavaSpout.name: Lava Spout
fairy/lavaSpout.description: Carbuncle transforms into a 3x3 pool of lava that expands outward during the Start Phase of each round until it becomes a 9x9 area. Lava deals 12 fire damage if you start your turn in it

fairy/overheat.name: Overheat
fairy/overheat.description: Carbuncle releases fire at all creatures within 2 tiles of you to deal fire damage

fairy/blessedRain.name: Blessed Rain
fairy/blessedRain.description:
Selkie ascends into the sky and transforms, causing it to rain heavily. On cast and during the Start Phase of each round the DM must place 3 Blessed droplets on the map, each within 2 tiles of a creature. Any ally that steps into its tile absorbs the droplet, regaining 3 HP.

Maintain: During the Start Phase you can spend 1 Focus and 8 Mana to continue the rain.

fairy/waterWhip.name: Water Whip
fairy/waterWhip.description: Selkie creates a tentacle of water and lashes at a target dealing water damage. You can target an ally instead for no damage.

fairy/hail.name: Hail
fairy/hail.description: Almiraj ascends into the sky and transforms, summoning baseball size hail. All creatures not underneath a roof take 5 water damage on cast and during the Start Phase.

fairy/snowCloak.name: Snow Cloak
fairy/snowCloak.description:
Almiraj shrouds the target with a magical aura that grants them resistance to water damage and lets them walk normally on ice. When it is snowing or hailing with this cloak attacks against you have a Bane. You may only have one Snow Cloak at a time.

Maintain: During the Start Phase you may spend 1 Focus and 1 Mana to maintain this effect for this round as well.

invention_hoverBoots.name: Hover Boots
invention_hoverBoots.description: Spend 2 Mana on use and during the Start Phase to have flying speed equal to your Speed for that round.

invention_heatGoggles.name: Heat Goggles (Low-light vision)
invention_heatGoggles.description: You can see through most obscuring vision like fog or smoke. You gain low-light vision.

invention_miningLight.name: Mining Light
invention_miningLight.description: A bright headlamp for working in dark spaces.

invention_rollerblades.name: Rollerblades
invention_rollerblades.description: Built-in wheels grant +2 Speed while this armor is equipped.

invention_robotTail.name: Robot Tail
invention_robotTail.description: Grants the robot tail weapon while this armor module is active.

invention_backSupport.name: Back Support
invention_backSupport.description: +1 Stability while this backpack is equipped.

invention_mechanicalArm.name: Mechanical Arm
invention_mechanicalArm.description: You gain a small mechanical arm that is attached to your belt. The arm cannot wield weapons or attack, but your first Interact action each turn costs 0 AP. It can hold 1H objects like a torch.

invention_manaTank.name: Mana Tank
invention_manaTank.description: +10 Max MP while this backpack is equipped.

invention_weaponInfusion_volt.name: Weapon Infusion (Volt)
invention_weaponInfusion_volt.description: While this backpack is equipped you may enable an infusion for your weapon with an Interact action. You may also disable it with an Interact action. This infusion cannot be overridden

invention_weaponInfusion_water.name: Weapon Infusion (Water)
invention_weaponInfusion_water.description: While this backpack is equipped you may enable an infusion for your weapon with an Interact action. You may also disable it with an Interact action. This infusion cannot be overridden

invention_weaponInfusion_fire.name: Weapon Infusion (Fire)
invention_weaponInfusion_fire.description: While this backpack is equipped you may enable an infusion for your weapon with an Interact action. You may also disable it with an Interact action. This infusion cannot be overridden

invention_weaponInfusion_earth.name: Weapon Infusion (Earth)
invention_weaponInfusion_earth.description: While this backpack is equipped you may enable an infusion for your weapon with an Interact action. You may also disable it with an Interact action. This infusion cannot be overridden

strikerSummon.name: Striker Type
strikerSummon.description: This summon can have 3 AP max per round and can make opportunity attacks

defenderSummon.name: Defender Type
defenderSummon.description: This summon can have 2 AP max per round and can make opportunity attacks

marksmanSummon.name: Marksman Type
marksmanSummon.description: This summon can have 2 AP max per round, but cannot make opportunity attacks

casterSummon.name: Caster Type
casterSummon.description: This summon can have 2 AP max per round, but cannot make opportunity attacks

utilitySummon.name: Utility Type
utilitySummon.description: This summon can have 3 AP max per round, but cannot make opportunity attacks

minionType.name: Minion Type
minionType.description: This minion can have 2 AP max per round and can make opportunity attacks. They die in one hit and fail every potency

unliving.name: Unliving
unliving.description: Immune to Bleeding, Charmed, Frightened, and Poisoned conditions. Also unaffected by Bard's Emanation songs

flammable.name: Flammable
flammable.description: After taking fire damage you are set alight, taking 3 fire damage at the start of your turn.

crafty.name: Crafty
crafty.description: You do not provoke opportunity attacks.

flying.name: Flying
flying.description: You have a flying speed equal to your speed.

extremeHeatSensitivity.name: Extreme heat sensitivity
extremeHeatSensitivity.description: If any fire damage is dealt to a target within 1 tile of this creature, this creature dies.

explosiveTendencies.name: Explosive tendencies
explosiveTendencies.description: When this creature dies it deals 2 fire damage to all creatures within 1 tile of it.

weakling.name: Weakling
weakling.description: Opportunity attacks deal 0 damage and this creature cannot attack with them.

largeFrame.name: Large frame
largeFrame.description: Counts as cover against ranged attacks for allies behind it.

undeadConstitution.name: Undead constitution
undeadConstitution.description: Damaged by most healing spells. Cannot be healed by most healing spells.

metaphysical.name: Metaphysical
metaphysical.description: Does not always exist on the physical plane, but may manifest or affect the physical world magically. Invisible to those unable to see metaphysical beings.

extraGrabby.name: Extra grabby
extraGrabby.description: Terrain this creature occupies is difficult terrain for hostile creatures as it tries to grab them.

trustyCompanion.name: Trusty companion
trustyCompanion.description: A small Beast or Plant assistant. Attacks use range centered on you, usually treated as Melee. Choose companion abilities when you take the Trusty Companion feat.

fairySylph.name: Sylph
fairySylph.description: Lesser fairy: a small blue-ish feather-winged humanoid, usually no taller than the length of your hand. Contract spells are chosen when you take the fairy in the character creator.

fairyWillOWisp.name: Will o' Wisp
fairyWillOWisp.description: Lesser fairy: a small blue orb with rounded feathered wings, body roughly the size of an apple; sometimes crackles with sparks.

fairyGnome.name: Gnome
fairyGnome.description: Lesser fairy: tan or brown humanoid wrapped in a robe, only a plain face visible.

fairyPixie.name: Pixie
fairyPixie.description: Lesser fairy: small green winged humanoid with butterfly-like wings, hand-sized.

fairySalamander.name: Salamander
fairySalamander.description: Lesser fairy: small red or orange lizard or amphibian.

fairyUndine.name: Undine
fairyUndine.description: Lesser fairy: humanoid made of water, roughly 5½ ft tall.

fairySprite.name: Sprite
fairySprite.description: Lesser fairy: whitish hand-sized humanoid without wings; floats.

fairyFlugel.name: Flugel
fairyFlugel.description: Greater fairy: dog-like creature with wing-like ear appendages.

fairyUnicorn.name: Unicorn
fairyUnicorn.description: Greater fairy: horse with a single horn on its forehead.

fairyGargoyle.name: Gargoyle
fairyGargoyle.description: Greater fairy: large bipedal stone creature with stone wings.

fairyDryad.name: Dryad
fairyDryad.description: Greater fairy: humanoid of plant matter, ~5½ ft tall.

fairyCarbuncle.name: Carbuncle
fairyCarbuncle.description: Greater fairy: fennec-fox-like creature with a gem in its forehead.

fairySelkie.name: Selkie
fairySelkie.description: Greater fairy: seal that swims through the air.

strawBird.name: Straw bird
strawBird.description: Geomancy utility Max 3 AP. Little to no damage; provides support. Assign actions when ready.

waxGolem.name: Wax golem
waxGolem.description: Geomancy minion Max 2 AP. Dies in one hit and fails all potencies; group minions share a turn in the slow phase. Typical mana cost 3 (rebalance as needed). Assign actions when ready.

snowGolem.name: Snow golem
snowGolem.description: Geomancy minion Max 2 AP. Dies in one hit and fails all potencies; group minions share a turn. Typical mana cost 3. Assign actions when ready.

woodGolem.name: Wood golem
woodGolem.description: Geomancy defender (rank 2). Tougher; cannot disengage; max 2 AP; attacks can slow or push. Assign actions when ready.

clayGolemChampion.name: Clay golem champion
clayGolemChampion.description: Geomancy striker (rank 2). Mobile striker; max 3 AP. Assign actions when ready.

strawGolem.name: Straw golem
strawGolem.description: Geomancy minion (rank 2). Typical mana cost 5. Assign actions when ready.

shielding.name: Shielding
shielding.description: Geomancy minion (rank 2). Typical mana cost 5. Assign actions when ready.

skeletonMarksman.name: Skeleton marksman
skeletonMarksman.description: Necromancy marksman (rank 1). Ranged physical damage; max 2 AP. Assign actions when ready.

shade.name: Shade
shade.description: Necromancy utility (rank 1). Little to no damage; support-focused. Assign actions when ready.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.description: Necromancy minion (rank 1). Typical mana cost 3. Assign actions when ready.

crawlingHands.name: Crawling hands
crawlingHands.description: Necromancy minion (rank 1). Typical mana cost 3. Assign actions when ready.

wight.name: Wight
wight.description: Necromancy defender (rank 2). Cannot disengage; max 2 AP; attacks can slow or push. Assign actions when ready.

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.description: Necromancy striker (rank 2). Mobile; max 3 AP. Assign actions when ready.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.description: Necromancy minion (rank 2). Typical mana cost 5. Assign actions when ready.

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
poltergeist.description: Necromancy minion (rank 2). Typical mana cost 5. Assign actions when ready.

bane.name: Bane
bane.description: -2 to Power Roll. If you have double Bane you don't get a bonus and automatically move to a lower tier of your result.

boon.name: Boon
boon.description: +2 to Power Roll. If you have double Boon you don't get a bonus and automatically move to a higher tier of your result.

reroll.name: Reroll
reroll.description: Only for power roll. You can reroll both dice or only 1.

blindsight.name: Blindsight
blindsight.description: You can detect creatures and objects within range, but you cannot perform more detailed work like reading text.

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.description: If you're in the dark you are treated as Blinded.

highGround.name: High Ground
highGround.description: If you are attacking from at least 2 tiles higher than your target you get a Boon automatically

lowLightVision.name: Low-light vision
lowLightVision.description: As long as there is a little bit of light such as the stars in the sky you can see in grayscale up to your Reason score in tiles. You cannot see anything in pitch black darkness such as deep in a cave or when there are no stars or moon in the sky at night.

bleeding.name: Bleeding
bleeding.description: You lose 2 HP for each AP you spend up to 3 AP. It is removed after you receive any healing. Does not stack.

blinded.name: Blinded
blinded.description: Other creatures are treated as being Concealed for the duration.

charmed.name: Charmed
charmed.description: The target treats you as a close friend and will act reasonably to help you. The effect ends prematurely if they take damage. You may treat Charmed characters and the charmer as if there was a mutual Bond of Affection between them.

dazed.name: Dazed
dazed.description: Lose 2 AP. You cannot use reactions. Does not take effect if target has Stunned.

frightened.name: Frightened
frightened.description: Gain a bane against all power rolls against the source of the fear. If that source is a creature it also gains a boon against you. You cannot willingly move closer to the source of fear. If you receive the frightened condition again from a different source then this new effect replaces the old one.

grabbed.name: Grabbed
grabbed.description: Your Speed is 0 and you move along with the grabber. If you are the one grabbing, and you are ever separated by more than 1 tile from the grabbed target, this effect ends. You can only grab one creature at a time

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.description: You lose 5 HP during End Phase.

prone.name: Prone
prone.description: Lying flat on the ground. All their attacks gain a bane and melee attacks against them gain a boon. Ranged attacks against them gain a bane. Movement costs doubled. You can stand up with the Change Posture action. Creatures can walk over you provided you are not more than 1 size larger than them.

restrained.name: Restrained
restrained.description: Speed is 0 and you cannot change posture. You take a Bane on Might and Dexterity rolls and attacks against you gain a Boon.

shaken.name: Shaken
shaken.description: Lose 1 AP. Does not take effect if target has Dazed or Stunned.

slowed.name: Slowed
slowed.description: Speed is capped at 2 and you cannot shift

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.description: Lose 3 AP. You cannot use reactions.

sundered.name: Sundered
sundered.description: Defense is reduced by half (round up).

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.description: If you target a creature other than the one that taunted you you have double bane on Power Rolls so long as there is line of sight between you and the source of the taunt.

weakened.name: Weakened
weakened.description: You gain a bane on Power Rolls for attacks.

1h.name: 1H
1h.description: This can only be done with a one-handed weapon

2h.name: 2H
2h.description: This can only be done with a two-handed weapon

barrierX.name: Barrier X
barrierX.description: Grants a Barrier equal to X. Barrier does not stack, but absorbs damage for you after defense but before affecting your HP.

blinded.name: Blinded
blinded.description: Other creatures are treated as being Concealed for the duration.

crushing.name: Crushing
crushing.description: Can only be used with a weapon that deals crushing damage

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Target and area selection occur on use, but the effect only occurs during End Phase. You must announce the target/area. It must used during the Fast Phase. If nothing is in the area or the target can no longer be targeted then you may choose to not activate the effect, but you still lose the resources spent. Otherwise you may choose to trigger the Delay effect anyways. If the target is an area it hits the area and if the target is a creature then you may fire at their last known location, potentially hitting terrain.

deployable.name: Deployable
deployable.description: This action spends IP to deploy an item.

emanation.name: Emanation
emanation.description: The area of effect is centered on you

extend.name: Extend
extend.description: If this attack is used with a weapon then the weapon's range expands by 1

firstStrike.name: First Strike
firstStrike.description: Can only be used during the first round of combat

flanking.name: Flanking
flanking.description: When you and another ally are adjacent to a hostile creature but on opposite sides you are both considered to be flanking that creature. This grants a boon against that creature for melee attacks.

heavy.name: Heavy
heavy.description: This action does not have an AP penalty for using a Heavy weapon.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.description: If target has Bleeding then immediately trigger Bleeding effect as if it spent 3 AP and remove Bleeding.

infusion.name: Infusion (Dmg Type)
infusion.description: The weapon's damage type is treated as the chosen damage type for the sake of vulnerabilities and resistances. The weapon does not deal magic damage if it did not before.

light.name: Light
light.description: This can only be done with a Light weapon

maintain.name: Maintain
maintain.description: You may only have one Maintain effect active at once. If you take excessive damage (equal or greater than your Willpower score) in one turn the effect ends. If you don't pay the Maintain cost then the effect ends.

manifest.name: Manifest
manifest.description: A Fairy or Fairy Tamer spell that has this tag dismisses the fairy as an assistant on use as the fairy transforms into the terrain effect described in the spell. While the spell persists the fairy cannot be re-summoned. You can dismiss the effect on your turn with an Interact action.

melee.name: Melee
melee.description: This is a melee attack and must be used within melee range

multiX.name: Multi (X)
multiX.description: You can target X creatures with this action. Does not affect area attacks and you cannot choose the same creature multiple times.

penetrateX.name: Penetrate (X)
penetrateX.description: Ignore up to X defense on an attack. This does stack with other Penetrate effects.

piercing.name: Piercing
piercing.description: Can only be used with a weapon that deals piercing damage

pullX.name: Pull X
pullX.description: Slide X towards the source in a straight line

pushX.name: Push X
pushX.description: Slide X away from the source in a straight line

rangedX.name: Ranged (X)
rangedX.description: This is a ranged attack and can be used up to the range of the action if included. Otherwise if this is used with a weapon then use the weapon's range.

repeatX.name: Repeat (X)
repeatX.description: You may repeat this action up to X times at no additional cost, keeping the same result tier. You may choose different targets each time

shiftX.name: Shift X
shiftX.description: Move X tiles. Does not trigger Opportunity Attacks. If you try to shift into or while within difficult terrain it would be treated as normal movement.

slashing.name: Slashing
slashing.description: Can only be used with a weapon that deals slashing damage

slideX.name: Slide X
slideX.description: Move the target X tiles, but not vertically

song.name: Song
song.description: This action is a Song from the Bard class.

spell.name: Spell
spell.description: This is a spell. It must be cast with eiter a free hand or Implement weapon.

stance.name: Stance
stance.description: This action is a Stance from the Brawler class. You cannot have multiple Stances active at once. If you activate a Stance while you already have one active then the previous one ends.

throwing.name: Throwing
throwing.description: This action can also be performed with a weapon with the Throwing tag. Throwing distance is your half your Might score (round down)

weapon.name: Weapon
weapon.description: This action is tied to a weapon you have equipped. Use the weapon's range, eligible attributes, and damage when the action or power roll says to add weapon damage.

warpX.name: Warp X
warpX.description: You teleport to that location without triggering opportunity attacks.

brawling.name: Brawling
brawling.description: A Brawling weapon represents weapons like your natural weapons like your fists, feet, tail, or gauntlets.

coating.name: Coating
coating.description: This item can be used to coat a weapon to add the item's effect as a potency to the weapon. The effect triggers the next time the weapon deals damage and this item is consumed when coating.

firearm.name: Firearm
firearm.description: This weapon is a firearm and using it for any attack always costs 3 Mana unless the action already comes with a Mana cost. Can't be used with Multi attacks and Area attacks consume 6 Mana.

heavy.name: Heavy
heavy.description: This equipment is heavy and requires a lot of Might to use effectively. You can only use this equipment if your Might is at least 13. If this is a weapon and you use its damage for an action that does not have the Heavy or Delay tag then the AP cost increases by 1, up to a maximum of 3.

implement.name: Implement
implement.description: This item can be used as an arcane implement for spellcasting. It cannot be used as a regular weapon.

light.name: Light
light.description: This weapon is lighter and can be used quickly

martial.name: Martial
martial.description: Can only be used if you have proficiency

reach.name: Reach
reach.description: This melee weapon has a range of 2

slowStart.name: Slow Start
slowStart.description: During your first round of combat you must take your turn during the Slow Phase

throwing.name: Throwing
throwing.description: This weapon can be thrown. Throwing distance is your half your Might score (round down)

specialInvention.name: Special Invention
specialInvention.description: This can only be obtained via Artificer's Special Invention passive

ally.name: Ally
ally.description: Either you or a friendly creature

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.description: The creature does not take turns during combat and does not have HP. It instead participates in combat in other ways such as by casting spells for you or useful passive abilities. You can only have 2 assistants active at a time. Actions taken from assistants are treated as if the assistant performed them and are not affected by effects that only affect you. Concealed Assistants such as Fairies to those who cannot see them do not gain a Boon for being Concealed.

bloodied.name: Bloodied
bloodied.description: The creature is at half HP or less

concealed.name: Concealed
concealed.description: If a creature is invisible or line of sight is otherwise obscured they are considered Concealed. Attacking a Concealed creature causes your attack to automatically have a Bane while they get a Boon when attacking you. A Concealed creature does not trigger an opportunity attack when leaving your melee range

metaphysical.name: Metaphysical
metaphysical.description: Does not always exist in the physical plane, but might be able to manifest itself or otherwise affect the physical world through magical or other means. They are invisible to those not able to see metaphysical beings.

minion.name: Minion
minion.description: The creature always dies in one hit and fails every potency check. No opportunity attacks. They all act on the same turn during the Slow Phase

summon.name: Summon
summon.description: The creature does take turns in combat and acts as another combatant. If its creator or summoner is downed then it also disappears. It must be given commands each round. You may only have one summon active at a time.

resistance.name: Resistance (RS)
resistance.description: Take half damage (round up) from a given damage type. If you somehow gain vulnerability to this damage type then these two effects cancel each other out.

vulnerability.name: Vulnerability (VU)
vulnerability.description: Take additional damage from a damage type. If you somehow gain resistance to this damage type then they cancel each other out. The amount of additional damage is specified with the vulnerability.

construct.name: Construct
construct.description: Immune to Poison damage. Cannot be healed by normal means.

corrupted.name: Corrupted
corrupted.description: Creatures of races that are permanently tainted with the energy of Chaos

undead.name: Undead
undead.description: Immune to Dark and Poison damage, Poisoned, and Vulnerability (5) to light damage. Healing damages them. Cannot be healed by normal means.

humanoid.name: Humanoid
humanoid.description: Any of the bipedal races blessed by the gods.

fairy.name: Fairy
fairy.description: Creatures created by Urkesh, the original god of nature. They are metaphysical by nature and possess a wide variety of elemental magic.

slime.name: Slime
slime.description: A creature made of some kind of viscous goo that sometimes has special properties such as being corrosive. They tend to be resistant to physical damage and some elements.

beast.name: Beast
beast.description: Most animals fall into this category

plant.name: Plant
plant.description: A plant that has somehow gained enough sentience or power

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: Powerful reptilian-like creatures created by Coriella.
